sa: पुरस्ताद् भूतपूर्वत्वाद्धीनभाग्यो हि दुर्मतिः। धातारं गर्हते नित्यं लब्धार्थश्च न मृष्यते॥
en: Only an unfortunate and foolish wight when divested of former prosperity, blames the supreme Ordainer, without being contented with his present position.

sa: ततः कृष्णोऽर्जुनं दृष्ट्वा कर्णास्त्रेण च पीडितम्। अभ्यसेत्यब्रवीत् पार्थमातिष्ठास्त्रं व्रजेति च॥
en: Seeing Arjuna thus assailed with Karna's arrows Krishna said to him "Go nearer to Karna and strike him with more powerful weapons."

sa: पूजयित्वा ततः पश्चादिदं वचनमब्रुवन्। शिष्ययोः कौशलं युद्धे पश्य रामेति पार्थिव॥
en: After adoring him, they then, O king said to him these words-"Witness, O Rama, the skill in battle of your two disciples.”

sa: युधिष्ठिर उवाच वैशसं सुमहत् कृत्वा ज्ञातीनां रोमहर्षणम्। आगस्कृत् सर्वलोकस्य पृथिवीनाशकारकः॥
en: Yudhishthira said Having caused a great and dreadful destruction of kinsmen, I have offended all and am a destroyer of the Earth.

sa: ततो बलानि सर्वाणि हतशिष्टानि भारत। प्रस्थितानि व्यदृश्यन्त मृत्युं कृत्वा निवर्तनम्॥
en: Then all the troops, stationed in their proper posts, were seen, O Bharata, to stand, clad in mail and determined to die.

sa: श्रुत्वा तत् त्वं तथाऽऽतिष्ठ यथा धर्मो न हीयते। धर्म वापि विप्रर्षे शृणु यत् ते ब्रवीम्यहम्॥
en: Hearing these words of the great Rishi, the Chandala answered him, saying,-Listen to me. Having heard these truthful words of mine, act in such a way that your religious merit may not suffer.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच युधिष्ठिरस्तु धर्मात्मा शोकव्याकुलचेतनः। शुशोच दुःखसंतप्तः स्मृत्वा कर्णं महारथम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said The righteous Yudhishthira, with an agitated heart and burning with grief, began to grieve for that powerful car warrior Karna.

sa: इतिहासपुराणार्थाः कार्येन विदितास्तवा धर्मशास्त्रं च सकलं नित्यं मनसि ते स्थितम्॥
en: You are the master-topics of histories and the Puranas. All the scriptures treating of duty and practice are centered in your memory.

sa: ते तत्र सादिनाः शूराः सौबलस्य महद् बलम्। रणमध्ये व्यतिष्ठन्त शरवर्षैरवाकिरन्॥
en: Those heroic horsemen, staying in the midst of their own elephants, enshrouded the large host of Subala's son with showers of arrows.

sa: दण्डे त्रिवर्गः सततं सुप्रणीते प्रवर्तते। दैवं हि परमो दण्डो रूपतोऽग्निरिवोत्थितः॥
en: The aggregate of three objects always depends well-applied Punishment. Punishment is a great god. In form he looks like a burning fire.

sa: यं विनिद्रा जितश्वासाः सत्त्वस्थाः संयतेन्द्रियाः। ज्योतिः पश्यन्ति युञ्जानास्तस्मै योगात्मने नमः॥
en: Casting off sleep, restraining vital airs, Yogins of controlled senses see you as eternal light. Salutations to you in your Yoga form.

sa: एवं विगणयन्नेव स मुनिमन्त्रपारगः॥ उत्पपाताश्रमात् तस्मादन्तरिक्षं विशाम्पते। जिज्ञासार्थं तदा भिक्षोर्जेगीषव्यस्य देवलः॥ सोऽन्तरिक्षचरान् सिद्धान् समपश्यत् समाहितान्। जैगीषव्यं च तैः सिद्धैः पूज्यमानमपश्यत॥
en: While immersed in these thoughts, the ascetic Devala, conversant with mantras then soared aloft, O king, from his hermitage into) the sky, for ascertaining who the mendicant Jaigishavya really was. Devala numbers of sky-ranging Siddhas rapt in meditation and Jaigishavya reverentially adored by thcm.

sa: यदा तु हीनं नृपतिर्विद्यादात्मानमात्मना। अमात्यैः सह सम्मन्त्र्य कुर्यात् संधि बलीयसा॥
en: When the king, after seeing everything finds himself weak, he should then, consulting with his ministers make peace with a stronger foe.

sa: सर्वभूतेष्वपि च वै ब्राह्मणो मोक्षमर्हति। कार्या चोपचितिस्तेषां सर्वस्वेनापि या भवेत्॥
en: Amongst creatures, Brahmanas should always be exempted by you in your plunders. By giving away everything you have you should adore them.

sa: कश्यपस्तां महाराज प्रतिगृह्य वसुन्धराम्॥ कृत्वा ब्राह्मणसंस्थां वै प्रविष्टः सुमहद् वनम्।
en: Kashyapa also, O king, having accepted the Earth in gift, and made a present of it to the Brahmanas, entered into woods.

sa: ततः स राजा तारुण्यादौरसेन बलेन च। ससार बाणासनभृत् सखगोऽसौ तनुत्रवान्॥
en: The king, young, active, and strong, and armed with bow and sword and protected with a coat of mail, still pursued it.

sa: तत् प्रमाणं ब्राह्मणानां शाश्वतं भरतर्षभ। तस्य धर्मस्य कृत्स्नस्य क्षत्रियः परिरक्षिता॥
en: Penances, therefore, O foremost of Bharata's race, are the eternal duty of the Brahmanas. A Kshatriya's duty is to protect all persons.

sa: ते पूर्वं पाण्डुपुत्रेण पृष्टा ह्यासन् सुतं तव। यदृच्छोपगतास्तत्र राजान् परिमार्गता॥
en: Sometime before, the son of Pandu, while searching for the king, had met those men and asked them the whereabouts of Duryodhana.

sa: मम चैव नियोगेन विधेश्चाप्यनिवर्तनात्। पाण्डवानां च कारुण्यात् प्राणान् धारय भारत।॥
en: At my behest, and knowing that which is ordained is inevitable, as also out of love for the Pandavas, live, O Bharata!

sa: असम्भावितरूपं हि त्वयि कर्म विगर्हितम्। शुक्ले रक्तमिव न्यस्तं भवेदिति मतिर्मम॥
en: This culpable deed, so impossible in one like you, will appear like a red spot on a white sheet. This my opinion.”

sa: पर्वतः पृथिवीं कृत्स्ना विचचार महामतिः॥ पूज्यमानो यथान्यायं तेजसा स्वेन भारत।
en: From that time the great Parvata began to wander over the Earth, respected as he deserved, O Bharata, for his own power.

sa: अर्थायैव हि केषांचिद् धननाशो भवत्युत। आनन्त्यं तत्सुखं मत्वा श्रियमन्यः परीप्सति॥
en: Some loss their wealth while seeking the same. Others consider wealth, as the source of endless happiness, and, therefore pursue it eagerly.

sa: वर्णानां परिचर्यार्थं त्रयाणां भरतर्षभ। वर्णश्चतुर्थः पश्चात् तु पद्भ्यां शूद्रो विनिर्मितः॥
en: For serving these three orders, O king, a fourth order, viz., the Shudra, came into being created from the feet (of Brahman).

sa: तदा नावैति चैवायं प्रकुर्वन् साध्वसाधु वा॥ तथैव परिरक्षिन्त ये ध्यानपरिनिष्ठितः। अयं न बुध्यते तावद् यमलोकमथागतम्॥
en: The person overcome by his senses does not know that death has come at his door. At last, dragged by the messengers of the Destroyer, he meets with death at the appointed time.

sa: स नः प्रथमजो भ्राता सर्वशस्त्रभृतां वरः॥ असूत तं भवत्यग्रे कथमद्भुतविक्रमम्।
en: Was that foremost of all holders of weapons our eldest brother? How did you give birth to that child of wonderful prowess?

sa: अस्मिंस्तीर्थवरे स्नात्वा स्कन्दं चाभ्यर्च्य लागली। ब्राह्मणेभ्यो ददौ रुक्मं वासांस्याभरणानि च॥
en: Having bathed in that Tirtha and adored Skanda, Rama gave to the Brahmans gold and clothes and ornaments and many other things.

sa: त्वं तु केवलमस्त्रज्ञो वीरव्रतसमन्वितः। शास्त्रार्थं तत्त्वतो गन्तुं न समर्थः कथंचन॥
en: You are conversant only with weapons and the practices of heroes. You are unable to understand correctly the meaning of the scriptures.

sa: न ते वेगं विषहितुं शक्तास्तव विशांपते॥ अस्माभिरपि गुप्तस्य तस्मादुत्तिष्ठ भारत।
en: They will not be able, O King, to withstand you specially when you will be protected by us. Arise therefore, O Bharata.

sa: य इमां वसुसम्पूर्णां वसुधां वसुधाधिपः। ददौ तस्मिन् महायज्ञे ब्राह्मणेभ्यः समाहितः॥
en: In one of his great sacrifices that king, gave away with full heart the entire Earth, abounding with wealth, to the Brahmanas.

sa: शक्रवीर्योपमा युद्धे दीप्तया वह्निस नास्तथा॥ शत्रूणां विग्रहे नित्यं भयदास्ता भवन्त्युत।
en: In battle, their energy esembled that of Shakra. In lustre they reseat-led fire. In battle they always struck terror to 'eir enemies.

sa: प्रतिज्ञा चाधिरोहस्व मनसा कर्मणा गिरा। पालयिष्याम्यहं भौमं ब्रह्म इत्येव चासकृत॥
en: Do you also swear that you would in thought, word, and deed, always maintain the religion laid on earth by the Vedas.

sa: यस्तु निःश्रेयसं श्रुत्वा ज्ञानं तत् प्रतिपद्यते। आत्मनो मतमुत्सृज्य तं लोकोऽनुविधीयते॥
en: He is obeyed in the world who, having listened to the advice of the wise, accepts them, leaving aside his own opinions.

sa: अनध्यायेषु ये विप्राः स्वाध्यायं नेह कुर्वते। तपोनिष्ठाः सुतपसो दुर्गाण्यतितरन्ति ते॥
en: Those Brahmanas, who never study the Vedas at improper hours, and who practise penances with devotion, succeed in getting over all difficulties.

sa: स पुनर्हदयं कस्य क्रूरस्यापि न निर्दहेत्। कस्य ह्यकरुणस्यापि नेत्राभ्यामश्रु नाव्रजेत्॥
en: Who is there so hard-hearted that would not fire up after having heard the cries of the king lying with broken thighs?

sa: परिष्वज्य च गान्धारी कृपणं पर्यदेवयत्। हा हा पुत्रेति शोकार्ता विललापाकुलेन्द्रिया॥
en: Embracing her son, Gandhari bewailed piteously. Stricken with grief, and growing unconscious, the Kuru queen exclaimed, 'Alas, O son!' 'Alas, O son.'

sa: स तैः परिवृतो राजा नक्षत्रैरिव चन्द्रमाः। अभ्याजगाम गाङ्गेयं ब्रह्माणमिव वासवः॥
en: Encircled by them, king Yudhishthira, like the moon in the midst of the stars, approached Ganga's son like Vasava proceeding towards Brahman.

sa: तस्य कन्याभवद् राजन् नाम्ना सत्यवतीप्रभो। तां गाधिर्भुगुपुत्राय सर्चीकाय ददौ प्रभुः॥
en: Gadhi had a daughter, O king, by the name of Satyavati. The powerful Gadhi married her to Richika a descendant of Bhrigu.

sa: युद्धेष्वपवदिष्यन्ति योधा नूनं वृकोदरम्। यावत् स्थास्यन्ति भूतानि निकृत्या ह्यसि पातितः॥२५
en: In all battles warriors will certainly censure Vrikodara as long as the world will exist. Forsooth, you have been struck down unrighteously.

sa: यथा क्रमेण पुष्पेभ्यश्चिनोति मधु षट्पदः। तथा द्रव्यमुपादाय राजा कुर्वीत संचयम्॥
en: As the bee gathers honey from flowers gradually, the king should collect wealth gradually from his kingdom for keeping it in store.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच विदुरस्य तु तद् वाक्यं श्रुत्वा तु पुरुषर्षभः। युज्यतां यानमित्युक्त्वा पुनर्वचनमब्रवीत्॥ शीघ्रमानय गान्धारीं सर्वाश्च भरतस्त्रियः। वधूं कुन्तीमुपादाय याश्चान्यास्तत्र योषितः॥
en: Vaishampayana said "Hearing these words of Vidura, that foremost of Bharata's race, viz., Dhritarashtra, ordered for his car. The king once more said,—'Bring Gandhari here forthwith, and all the Bharata ladies. Bring here Kunti also, as well as all the other ladies with her.

sa: ततः प्रत्यर्चितः सद्भिर्धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः। प्रतिपेदे महद् राज्यं सुहृद्भिः सह भारत॥
en: Thus worshipped by those pious men, king Yudhishthira, with his friends, became installed on the throne of a large kingdom, O Bharata.

sa: तावकाः समरे राजन् रक्षिता दृढधन्वना। प्रत्युद्ययुश्च तांस्ते तु समन्ताद् विगतव्यथा:॥
en: Then your soldiers O king, protected in battle by that firm bowman, cheerfully rushed against the enemy once more from all sides.

sa: तत्त्वं ज्ञात्वा नु सोमस्य विक्रयः स्याददोषवान्। असमर्थस्य भृत्यस्य विसर्गः स्याददोषवान्। वनदाहो गवामर्थे क्रियमाणो न दूषकः॥
en: One who knows the true uses of the Soma juice, does not commit sin by selling it. By dismissing a servant who is incapable of doing service, one is not visited with sin.

sa: दृष्ट्वा तु तानापततः सम्प्रहृष्टान् महारथान्। पराक्रान्तास्ततो वीरा निराशा जीविते तदा॥
en: Beholding those brave, heroic and powerful car-warriors rushing joyously towards them, your soldiers, whose faces grew pale, became despondent of their lives.

sa: ततो ये क्षत्रिया राजन् शतशस्तेन वर्जिताः॥ ते विवृद्धा महावीर्याः पृथिवीपतयोऽभवन्।
en: Those Kshatriyas, however, king counting by hundreds, that were not killed by Rama, multiplied (in time) and became powerful monarchs on Earth.

sa: न वासुदेवात् त्वत्तो वा पाण्डवेय बिभेम्यहम्। त्वं हि क्षत्रियदायादो महाकुलविवर्धनः। अतस्त्वां प्रब्रवीम्येष मुहूर्तं क्षम पाण्डव॥
en: Neither Krishna, nor you fear me the least. You are a Kshatriya and the scion of an illustrious family. Remembering the dictates of virtue, excuse me for a moment, O son of Pandu.

sa: कालवर्षी च पर्जन्यः सस्यानि समपादयत्। नित्यं सुभिक्षमेवासीद् रामे राज्यं प्रशासति॥
en: The clouds, pouring rain in season, caused the crops to grow profusely. During his regime, food was always abundant in his kingdom.

sa: ततः स भृगुशार्दूलः कार्तवीर्यस्य वीर्यवान्॥ विक्रम्य निजघानाशु पुत्रान् पौत्रांश्च सर्वशः।
en: Then that foremost of the Bhrigus, endued with great energy, displaying his prowess, quickly killed all the sons and grandsons of Kartavirya.

sa: भयानमन्ति राजानो यस्य स्म शतसंघशः। स वीरशयने शेते क्रव्याद्भिः परिवारितः॥
en: He to whom hundreds of kings used to bow down in fear, lies to-day on the battle-field, encircled by beasts of prey!

sa: भीमसेनं रणे क्रुद्धो द्रोणपुत्रो न्यवारयत्॥
en: The son of Drona opposed in that battle the angry Bhimasena.

sa: तथान्यानपि स प्राह राजकोशहरांस्तदा। न चास्य वचनं किंचिदनृतं श्रूयते क्वचित्॥
en: The sage then mentioned the names of other officers who had likewise been guilty of embezzlement, adding,-My crow never says anything false!

sa: एवमेतानि कालेन प्रियद्वेष्याणि भागशः। जीवेषु परिवर्तन्ते दुःखानि च सुखानि च॥
en: These in course of Time. become objects of love or hatred, and appearing as happiness or misery revolve for affecting living creatures.

sa: नारायणं नमस्कृत्य नरं चैव नरोत्तमम्। देवी सरस्वतीं व्यासं ततो जयमुदीरयेत्।।
en: Having saluted the Narayana and Nara the foremost of male beings, as also the goddess of learning Sarasvati let us cry success.

sa: इदं कायव्यचरितं यो नित्यमनुचिन्तयेत्। नारण्येभ्यो हि भूतेभ्यो भयं प्राप्नोति किंचन॥
en: He, who always meditates on this narrative of Kayavya will have no fear from the forestrangers, in fact, from any earthly creature.

sa: प्राक्कर्मभिस्तु भूतानि भवन्ति न भवन्ति च। एवं सांसिद्धिके लोके किमर्थमनुतप्यसे॥
en: Creatures are born or destroyed according to their pristine acts. When such is the course of the world, why do you grieve?

sa: गोसहस्रं सवत्सानां दोग्ध्रीणां प्राणसंशये। साधुभ्यो वै दरिद्रेभ्यो दत्त्वा मुच्येत किल्बिषात्॥
en: One who, at the time of death, presents a thousand kine with calves to poor but deserving persons, becomes freed for sin.

sa: युधिष्ठिरस्तु धर्मात्मा मां धर्माननुपृच्छतु। एवं प्रीतो भविष्यामि धर्मान् वक्ष्यामि चाखिलान्॥
en: Let the righteous-souled Yudhishthira enquire of me about morality and duty. I shall then be much pleased to speak of all duties.

sa: सोऽहं हताशो दुर्बुद्धिः कृतस्तेन दुरात्मना। धार्तराष्ट्रेण राजेन्द्र पश्य मन्दात्मतां मम॥
en: Fool that I am, Dhritarashtra's wicked son, Duryodhana, destroyed the hope I had entertained. Mark, O king, the foolishness of my mind.

sa: ताः सृष्टमात्राः क्षुधिताः प्रजाः सर्वाः प्रजापतिम्। बिभक्षयिषवो राजन् सहसा प्राद्रवंस्तदा॥
en: As soon, as they were born, they ran, O king, towards their father,. stricken with hunger and desirous of eating him up.

sa: अपक्रम्य तु ते राजन् सर्व एव महारथाः। आमन्त्र्यान्योन्यमुद्विग्नास्त्रिधा ते प्रययुस्तदा॥
en: Leaving thàt place, O king those great carwarriors, with hearts stricken with anxiety, took one another's leave and separated from one another.

sa: वृताः समरे पञ्च गजानीकेन भारत) अशोभन्त महाराज ग्रहा व्याप्ता घनैरिव॥
en: Encompassed by that elephant, O Bharata, the five brothers looked beautiful, O foremost of men, like the planets surrounded by the clouds.

sa: इत्येष दण्डो विख्यात आदौ मध्ये तथावरे। भूमिपालो यथान्यायं वर्तेतानेन धर्मवित्॥
en: Thus Punishment also keeps awake in the beginning, the middle and the end. A virtuous king should duly rule, guided by Punishment.

sa: तत्रस्थश्चापि शुश्राव हतं शल्यं हलायुधः॥ तत्रापि दत्त्वा दानानि द्विजातिभ्यः परंतपः। शुश्राव शल्यं संग्रामे निहतं पाण्डवैस्तदा॥
en: While there, Baladeva heard of the destruction of Shalya. Having made presents to the Brahmanas there, he bewailed, O destroyer of foes, for Shalya, who had been killed by the Pandavas in battle.

sa: भीष्म उवाच नियतस्त्वं नरव्याघ्र शृणु सर्वमशेषतः। यथा राज्यं समुत्पन्नमादौ कृतयुगेऽभवत्॥
en: 'With rapt attentical, O foremost of kings, listen to it fully as to how in the golden cycle sovereignty was first instituted.

sa: तमुवाच किल पृथा पुनः पृथुलवक्षसम्॥ चतुर्णामभयं देहि कामं युध्यस्व फाल्गुनम्।
en: Thus answered, Pritha once more addressed her son having broad chest and said,-'Fight with Phalguna then, but spare my four other sons.

sa: गान्धार्युवाच अध्यर्धगुणमाहुर्यं बले शौर्ये च केशव। पित्रा त्वया च दाशार्ह दृप्तं सिंहमिवोत्कटम्। यो बिभेद चमूमेको मम पुत्रस्य दुर्भिदाम्। स भूत्वा मृत्युरन्येषां मम पुत्रस्य मृत्युवशं गतः॥
en: Gandhari said He whose power and bravery were regarded, O Keshava, as a one and half times superior to those of his father and you, he who took after a dreadful and proud, lion, he who alone pierced the impenetrable army of my son, he who killed many, alas, he now sleeps there, himself dead.

sa: विनीतक्रोधहर्षा हि मन्दा वनमुपाश्रिताः। विना वधं न कुर्वन्ति तापसा: प्राणयापनम्॥
en: Only the foolish (Kshatriyas) controlling anger and joy, dwell in the woods. The very ascetics cannot maintain their lives without killing creatures.

sa: भीमसेनमुपासेदुः प्रवणादिव कुञ्जरम्। ततः क्रुद्धो रणे भीमः शिरो दुर्मर्षणस्य ह॥
en: Worked up with anger, Bhimasena, quickly cut off the head of Durmarshana with a razorheaded arrow and threw it on the Earth.

sa: तमुत्तीर्णं तु सम्प्रेक्ष्य समहष्यन्त सर्वशः। पञ्चाला: पाण्डवेयाश्च तेऽन्योन्यस्य तलान् ददुः॥
en: Seeing him, however, rise from within the lake, all the Panchalas and the Pandavas began to rejoice and seize each others hands.

sa: न हि त्वं रथिनां श्रेष्ठं प्रगृहीतवरायुधम्। जेतुमुत्सहते शश्वदपि देवेषु वासवः॥
en: No one, not even Vasava amongst the celestials, would venture to defeat you armed with best of weapons, O foremost of carwarriors.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच ततः पृथिव्या निर्दिशंस्तान् समानीय कश्यपः। अभ्यषिञ्चन्महीपालान् क्षत्रियान् वीर्यसम्मतान्॥
en: Vasudeva said are Then finding out those energetic Kshatriyas whom the goddess had named, the sage Kashyapa installed them duly as kings.

sa: तच्छिरो नमुचेश्छिन्नं पृष्ठतः शक्रमन्वियात्॥ भो भो मित्रघ्न पापेति ब्रुवाणां शक्रमन्तिकात्।
en: The severed head of Namuchi thereupon pursued Indra from behind, saying repeatedly from a near place-"O killer of a friend, O wretch!'

sa: स्मितोपपन्नं सुनसं सुभ्रु ताराधिपोपमम्। अतीव शुभ्रं वदनं कृष्ण पश्य विविंशतः॥
en: Look, O Krishna, at his very beautiful and smiling face, having excellent nose and beautiful eyebrows, and resembling the shining Moon himself.

sa: यतः शङ्का भवेच्चापि भृत्यतोऽथापि मन्त्रितः। पौरेभ्यो नृपतेर्वापि स्वाधीनान् कारयीत तान्॥
en: The king should speedily subjugate such persons as may cause fear, be they his servants or counsellors or citizens or neighbouring kings.

sa: जनमेजय उवाच किमर्थं भगवान् शक्रो ब्रह्मवध्यामवाप्तवान्॥ कथमस्मिंश्च तीर्थे वै आप्लुत्याकल्मषोऽभवत्।
en: Janamejaya said "Why was Indra affected with the sin of Brahmanicide! How also did he become freed by bathing in that tirtha?''

sa: मध्यमानां तु नारीणां वृद्धानां चापराजित। आक्रन्दं हतबन्धूनां दारुणे वैशसे शृणु॥
en: Hear, O unvanquished one, the loud lamentations of those elderly ladies and those others of middle age on witnessing this terrible destruction.

sa: कृत्वा हि विविधं कर्म तत्तद् विविधलक्षणम्। पार्थिवैर्नृपतिः स्वल्पैः कारणैरेव बध्यते॥
en: Having performed various acts according to the diverse means of royal policy, insignificant kings, often destroy a great king through some contrivance.

sa: स ददर्श शयानं तं गतासुं पीतशोणितम्। कुमारं विगतानन्दं निशाकरमिव च्युतम्॥
en: He saw his son there, his blood quaffed off and lying dead on the ground like the moon dropped from the sky.

sa: अमित्रा एव राजानं भेदेनोपचरन्त्युत। तां राजा निकृति जानन् यथामित्रान् प्रबाधते॥
en: Enemies frequently injure a king by creating disunion. The king, conversant with deceit, may, by the help of deceit, counteract those enemies.

sa: अत्रैव वावरोहैनमेष धर्मः सनातनः। यदि मे प्रथमं द्रोणः शरीरे प्रहरिष्यति। ततोऽस्य प्रहरिष्यामि नास्य कोपो भवेदिति॥ अस्याविदूरे हि धनुर्ध्वजाये यस्य दृश्यते!
en: I shall salute him there for such is the ever abiding duty. If Drona at first strikes my body. I shall strike him then and he will not be angry for it. Near him at whose flag the mark of a bow is seen.

sa: अप्रदानेन राज्यस्य यदि कृष्ण सुयोधनः। संधिमिच्छेन्न कर्तव्यं तत्र गत्वा कथञ्चन॥
en: If, O Krishna, Suyodhana desires peace without returning the kingdom; then it is by no means proper that you should go there.

sa: कस्यचित् त्वथ कालस्य व्यासः सत्यवतीसुतः॥ आजगाम महायोगी पाण्डवानवलोककः। तमागतमभिप्रेक्ष्य कुन्तीपुत्रो युधिष्ठिरः॥ प्रत्युद्गम्य महात्मानं प्रत्यगृह्णाद् यथाविधि।
en: After a while the son of Satyavati, Vyasa, the great Yogi came there to see the Pandavas. Seeing him coming, the son of Kunti, Yudhishthira, went forward and duly received that high-souled one.

sa: पाल्यमानास्त्वया ते हि निवसन्ति गतज्वराः। नार्हस्येवंगते मन्युं कर्तुं प्राकृतवद् यथा॥
en: Under your protection, the Pandavas are residing in your dominion in great happiness. You should not indulge in sorrow like ordinary people.

sa: असंख्येया गुणाः पार्थे तद्विशिष्टो जनार्दनः। त्वमेव भूयो जानासि कुन्तीपुत्र धनंजयम्॥
en: Innumerable are the virtues of the son of Pritha; Janardana excels him however. You know very well Dhananjaya the son of Kunti.

sa: ततस्ते कुरवः सर्वे साधु साध्विति चाब्रुवन्। दुष्करं कृतवान् भीष्मो यदर्जुनमयोधयत्॥
en: All Kauravas at that moment thanked Bhishma by saying-"Hurrah! Bhishma has showed this rare valour as to wage battle against Arjuna. a

sa: सोऽस्मानतळयद् भोक्तुमथाभ्येत्य वचोऽब्रवीत्। भोः क एष मम भ्रातुर्जटायोः कुरुते कथाम्॥
en: And desirous of devouring us, he approached us and spoke these words “who is it that is speaking of my brother Jatayu?

sa: न तु पश्यामि योद्धारमात्मन: सदृशं भुवि। ऋते तस्मान्नरव्याघ्रात् कुन्तीपुत्राद् धनंजयात्॥
en: I do not see any soldier equal to me in this world save that best among men Dhananjaya, the son of Kunti.

sa: श्रीमतः पाण्डवान् दृष्ट्वा ज्वलतः पावकानिव। मुहूर्तमिव च ध्यात्वा सरोषः पृथिवीपतिः॥
en: Beholding the beautiful Pandavas, who shone there like burning fire, the king thought for a moment and was worked up with anger.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवं चिन्तापरिगतो दुःशासनमथाब्रवीत्। दुःशासन निबोधेदं वचनं मम भारत॥
en: Vaishampayana said : When he was thus bewailing, he thus spoke to Dushasana, "O Dushasana, O descendant of Bharata, hear my words.

sa: पाण्डवस्य तु शीघ्रास्त्रं मघवा प्रत्यपूजयत्। गन्धर्वाप्सरसाचैव ये च तत्र समागताः॥
en: Even Indra spoke highly of the lighthandedness Arjuna in the discharge of arrows, as also the Gandharvas and Apsaras who came there.

sa: धूमच्छाया ह्यभजतां नेत्रे चोच्छ्रित श्मणी। सस्वेदा भृकुटी चोग्रा ललाटे समवर्तत॥
en: His eyes with their lashes upraised, assumed the aspect of smoky dark, and terrible wrinkles covered with sweat appeared on his forehead.

sa: प्रियो बहुतमश्चासं नर्तको गीतकोविदः। आचार्यवच्च मां नित्यं मन्यते दुहिता तव॥
en: Well-versed in dancing and singing, I was always loved and much liked by her. Your daughter always regards me as her preceptor.

sa: तत् प्रणुद्य रथानीकं सिंहसंहननो युवा। कुरूंस्तान् प्रहसन् राजन् संस्थितान् हृतवाससः॥१०।
en: Having assailed those mighty car-warriors the Kurus. O king, the youth, powerful as a lion, laughed and stripped them off their robes.

sa: तं राजसिंहं प्रतिगृह्य राजा प्रीत्याऽऽत्मना चैनमिदं बभाषे। कामेन ताताभिवदाम्यहं त्वां कस्यासि राज्ञो विषयादिहागतः॥ गोत्रं च नामापि च शंस तत्त्वतः। किं चापि शिल्पं तव विद्यते कृतम्॥
en: Having appointed him the best of kings, O king, glad at heart addressed him saying “O worshipful one I bow down to you" from the dominions of what king you are come here? Please tell me truly what your name is and what family you belong to and whether you have knowledge of any art.

sa: दृष्ट्वा युधिष्ठिरं राजन् क्षिप्रमेध्ये नराधिप। अवश्यं चापि द्रष्टव्यः पाण्डवः पुरुषर्षभः॥
en: Having seen Yudhishthira, I shall come soon, O king. That best among men the son of Pandu, must be seen by me.

sa: यावत् स्थास्यन्ति गिरयः सरितश्च जनार्दन। तावत् कीर्तिभवः शब्दः शाश्वतोऽयं भविष्यति॥
en: So long as mountains and lakes will exist, O Janardana, so long will the fame of this event last-that is for ever.

sa: यदर्थं निहतो वाली मया रघुकुलोद्वह। त्वया सह महाबाहो किष्किन्धोपवने तदा॥
en: And for whose sake, O mighty-armed perpetuator of Raghu's race, I have, with your assistance slain Bali in the pleasure-gardens of Kishkindha.

sa: मृत्युर्मे पत्युराख्यातो नारदेन महात्मना। स चाद्य दिवसः प्राप्तस्ततो नैनं जहाम्यहम्॥
en: The high-souled Narada had fore told the death of my husband. Today being the appointed time, I did not leave his company.

sa: द्वाविमौ पुरुषौ राजन् स्वर्गस्योपरि तिष्ठतः। प्रभुश्च क्षमया युक्तो दरिद्रश्च प्रदानवान्॥
en: These two men, O king, are placed above heaven, viz. the powerful man graced with forgiveness and the poor man with charity.

sa: प्रतिपेदे हृषीकेशः शार्ङ्ग च धनुरुत्तमम्। रुक्मी तु विजयं लब्ध्वा धनुर्मेघनिभस्वनम्॥
en: Hrishikesha obtained that excellent bow the Sharanga. Rukmi, obtaining that bow called Vijaya whose twang was like the roaring of the clouds.

sa: यत् ते सभामध्ये अर्जुन उवाच कर्ण बहु वाचा विकत्थितम्। न मे युधि समोऽस्तीति तदिदं समुपस्थितम्॥
en: Arjuna said O Karna, this is the time for you to make good the boastful words you gave vent to in the midst of assembly, 'there is none equal to me in fight.'

sa: दुःखानि हि महात्मानः प्राप्नुवन्ति युधिष्ठिर। देवैरपि हि दुःखानि प्राप्तानि जगतीपते॥
en: 0 Yudhishthira, great minded persons, meet with difficulties. O Lord of the world, difficulties have been met with by the gods too.

sa: कृष्णाद्वितीयो विक्रम्य तुष्ट्यर्थं जातवेदसः। अजयद् य: पुरा वीरो युध्यमानं पुरंदरम्॥
en: That hero who, in days of old, for the satisfaction of the god of fire, aided by Krishna, conquered Purandara (Indra) fighting.

sa: यथा रश्मिभिरादित्यः प्रच्छादयति मेदिनीम्। तथा गाण्डीवनिर्मुक्तैः शरैः पार्थो दिशो दश॥
en: Partha soon filled the ten quarters with arrows shot from his Gandiva bow as the sun covers the earth with its rays.

sa: जेतारं देवदैत्यानां सर्वेषां च महारथम्॥ अविभ्रमं च शिक्षां च लाघवं दूरपातिताम्। पार्थस्य समरे दृष्ट्वा द्रोणस्याभूच्च विस्मयः॥ अथ गाण्डीवमुद्यम्य दिव्य धनुरमर्षणः। विचकर्ष रणे पार्थो बाहुभ्यां भरतर्षभ॥ तस्य बाणमयं वर्षं शलभानामिवायतिम्। दृष्ट्वा ते विस्मिताः सर्वे साधु साध्वित्यपूजयन्॥६५। न च बाणान्तरे वायुरस्य शक्नोति सर्पितम्।
en: The conqueror of the celestials and Daityas and of all mighty car-warriors. Beholding in battle Partha's certain aim, training, lightness of hand and the range (of his arrows), Drona was stricken greatly with wonder. Then taking up with his hands the celestials bow Gandiva, the energetic Partha, O foremost of Bharatas, drew it. Beholding the downpour of his shafts coming down like a swarm of locusts, they, all filled with wonder, exclaimed “Well done! well done!" Even the very air could not penetrate into the space intervening between his arrows.

sa: कृष्णेन सहितात् को वै न व्यथेत धनंजयात्। कोऽद्य भीतं न मां विद्यात् पार्थानां समितिं गतम्॥
en: Who am not afraid of Dhananjaya united with Krishna; and who would not consider me to be struck with fear if I go over to the side of the sons of the Pritha.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच मया नागपुरं गत्वा सभायां धृतराष्ट्रजः। तथ्यं पथ्यं हितं चोक्तो न च गृह्णाति दुर्मतिः॥
en: Vasudeva said Going to Nagapur I said to him who is born of Dhritarashtra words which are true, opportune and conducive to his interests but he of wicked mind did not accept them.

sa: स यत् काष्ठं तृणं वापि शिलां वा क्षेप्स्यते मयि। सर्वं तद् धारयिष्याभि स ते सेतुर्भविष्यति॥
en: And whatsoever he may throw into my waters, whether it be a piece of wood or a straw or a stone, I will support them all and which will be bridge to you."

sa: स एष पार्थो विक्रान्तः सव्यसाची परंतपः। नायुद्धेन निवर्तेत सर्वैरपि सुरासुरैः॥
en: He is the powerful Partha, Savyasachin, the repressor of enemies he does no desist even in the encounter with all the celestials.

sa: विश्वामित्रोऽथ तं दृष्ट्वागालवं चाध्वनि स्थितः। उवाच वदतां श्रेष्ठो वैनतेयस्य संनिधौ॥
en: Vishvamitra, while standing on the path, saw Galava and that foremost among speakers said in the presence of the son of Vinata.

sa: सर्वा दिशः सम्पतता रथेन रजोध्वस्तं गाण्डिवेन प्रकृत्तम्। यदा द्रष्टा स्वबलं सम्प्रमूढं तदा पश्चात् तप्स्यति मन्दबुद्धिः॥
en: When he sees his own army covered by the dust of my chariot going in all sides cut down by my Gandiva and rendered senseiess; then will that man of weak intellect repent.

sa: स तस्मिन् संकुले सैन्ये द्रौपदीमवतार्य ताम्। प्राणप्रेप्सुरुपाधावद् वनं येन नराधमः॥
en: Getting Draupadi down, the wretch, in the confusion, fled away for life following the same forest path by which he had come.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच अथाब्रवीन्महावीर्यो द्रोणस्तत्त्वार्थदर्शिवान्। न तादृशा विनश्यन्ति न प्रयान्ति पराभवम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Thereupon the highly energetic and greatly wise Drona said : "Persons like them can never meet with destruction of discomfiture."

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच पितुरेतद् वचः श्रुत्वा धार्तराष्ट्रोऽत्यमर्षणः। आधाय विपुलं क्रोधं पुनरेवेदमब्रवीत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having heard these words of his father, the extremely passionate son of Dhritarashtra became highly enraged and again said this-

sa: अनारभ्या भवन्त्याः केचिन्नित्यं तथागताः। कृतः पुरुषकारो हि भवेद् येषु निरर्थकः॥
en: Acts should not be commenced, which cannot be done for certain and which, if commenced, render the exertions of a man fruitless.

sa: संजयं च महाभागमृषींश्चैव तपोधनान्। प्रादात् तेषां स भगवान् दिव्यं चक्षुर्जनार्दनः॥
en: And Sanjaya of great power. And those Rishis whose only wealth consisted in devotion for the lord Janardana, gave them celestial sight.

sa: यत् तु सा बृहती श्यामा एकवस्त्रा सभां गता। अशृणोत् परुषा वाचः किं न दुःखतरं ततः॥
en: As that youthful Krishna, clothed in a single raiment brought into the Assembly Hall and that she was made to listen to harsh and insulting words, what can be more painful than that.

sa: तथा तान् द्रवतो योधान् दृष्ट्वा तौ दूषणानुजौ। अवस्थाप्याथ सौमित्रिं संक्रुद्धावभ्यधावताम्॥
en: Then, the two younger brothers of Dushana, seeing those warriors fly away, rallied them and rushed furiously against the son of Sumitra.

sa: का त्वं ब्रूहि यथा भद्रे नासि दासी कथंचना यक्षी वा यदि वा देवी गन्धर्वी यदि वाप्सराः॥ देवकन्या भुजङ्गी वा नगरस्याथ देवता। विद्याधरी किन्नरी वा यदि वा रोहिणी स्वयम्॥ अलम्बुषा मिश्रकेशी पुण्डरीकाथ मालिनी। इन्द्राणि वारुणी वा त्वं त्वष्टुर्धातुः प्रजापतेः। देव्यो देवेषु विख्यातास्तासां त्वं कतमा शुभे॥
en: O gentle one, tell me who you are; you cannot be a maid-servant; are you a Yakshi or a goddess, a Gandharvi or an Apsara (nymph)? are you the daughter of a celestials or female Naga? is a presiding deity of the city? Are you a Vidyadhari or a Kinnari or Rohini herself? Are you Alambusha or Mishrakeshi Pundarika or Malini or the queen of Indra or Varuna, or are you the wife of Vishvakarma or of the Prajapati himself? These goddesses are renowned in the regions of celestials; of these who are you, O beautiful one?

sa: विसृज्य धृतराष्ट्राय राज्यं सविदुराय च। चचार पृथिवीं पाण्डुः सर्वां परपुरञ्जयः॥
en: Having made over the kingdom to Dhritarashtra and Vidura Pandu, that conqueror of the cities of his enemies, wandered over the earth.

sa: स्वं चैव वपुरास्थाय बभूव स बलान्वितः। अब्रवीच्च गुरुं देवो बृहस्पतिमवस्थितम्॥
en: Having gained his own form he became endowed with strength and the god thus addressed his preceptor who was standing before him.

sa: तस्य तत् सर्वमाचख्यौ सीताया लक्ष्मणो वचः। यदुक्तवत्यसदृशं वैदेही पश्चिमं वचः॥
en: Lakshmana then informed Rama of everything that Sita had said to him, especially the harsh words with which she subsequently rebuked him.

sa: प्रोक्षिता यत्र बहवो वराहाद्या मृगा वने। शक्रेण यज्ञभागार्थं दैवतेषु प्रकल्पिताः॥
en: Here were massacred many boars and Other animals by Shakra to be used as offerings for sacrificial ceremonies dedicated to the gods.

sa: द्रवतस्तांस्तु सम्प्रेक्ष्य स वज्री दानवानिव। शतं पञ्चाधिकं भीमः प्राहिणोद् यमसादनम्॥ वृक्षेणैतेन राजेन्द्र प्रभवानसुतो बली। तत आश्वासयत् कृष्णां स विमुच्य विशाम्पते।॥
en: Beholding them thus taking to their heels, the powerful Bhima, the son of the Wind-god, dispatched with that tree, O king, hundred and five of them to the abode of death, like the wielder of thunder-bolt, the Danavas. Then releasing Krishna he comforted her.

sa: तेषां सत्त्ववतां मध्ये गोविन्दं सहचारिणम्। चिरस्य दृष्ट्वा वार्ष्णेयं बाष्पमाहारयत् पृथा॥
en: Seeing Govinda after a long time, the action of the Vrishni race, companion of her sons, endued with prowess, Pritha shed tears.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच धृतराष्ट्रस्ततो भीष्ममनुमान्य प्रसाद्य च। अवभय॑ च राधेयमिदं वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Then Dhritarashtra, having pleased Bhishma by approving of his words and having rebuked the son of Radha, said these words.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्तः प्रत्युवाच पश्यामि द्रौपदीमिति॥ पति: सौवीरसिन्धूनां दुष्टभावो जयद्रथः।
en: Vaishampayana said: Being thus addressed the evil-minded Jayadratha, the king of Sindhu, Sauvira and other countries said: "I wish to see Draupadi.”

sa: एष ते वैष्णवो नाम यज्ञः सत्पुरुषोचितः॥ एतेन नेष्टवान् कश्चिदृते विष्णुं पुरातनम्। राजसूयं क्रतुश्रेष्ठं स्पर्धत्येष महाक्रतुः॥
en: This sacrifice worthy to be performed by virtuous men is called Vaishnava. No person except the ancient Vishnu has ever performed it. This great sacrifice vies with that foremost of sacrifices, the Rajasuya.

sa: नारद उवाच इयं भोगवती नाम पुरी वासुकिपालिता। यादृशी देवराजस्य पुरीवर्याऽमरावती॥
en: Narada said This city is named Bhogavati, ruled by Vasuki, which is similar to the city of the king of the gods-Amaravati.

sa: स स्म नित्यं निशापाये प्रातरुत्थाय वीर्यवान्। ब्राह्मणान् क्षत्रियांश्चैव पृच्छन्नास्ते महारथः॥
en: Every day at the end or night, that great and heroic car-warrior, rising up, used to ask the Brahmanas and Krishna Kshatriyas.

sa: अपि दुर्योधनं कृष्ण सर्वे वयमधश्चराः। नीचैर्भूत्वानुयास्यामो मा स्म नो भरतानशन्॥
en: We would rather, O Krishna, follow the lead of Duryodhana and be under his control; but let not the Bharatas be destroyed.

sa: एवंबुद्धिः पाण्डवेषु मिथ्यावृत्तिः सदा भवान्। कथं ते नापराधोऽस्ति पाण्डवेषु महात्मसु॥
en: Such was ever your inclination and treacherous treatment towards the sons of Pandu; how have you not then offended the great-souled Pandavas?

sa: एकतो ह्यस्य दाराश्च ज्ञातयश्च सबान्धवाः। आत्मा च पृथिवी चेयमेकतश्च धनंजयः॥
en: Krishna considers his wives, cousins and his friends, his soul and the earth on one side equal to Dhananjaya on the other.

sa: तस्य शब्दो महानासीद् धम्यमानस्य जिष्णुना। तथा वीर्यवता संख्ये पर्वतस्येव दीर्यतः॥
en: Blown on the battle-field by the powerful Vishnu the sound of that conch appeared like that of the clapping of a mountain.

sa: स कोटिकास्यं राजानमब्रवीत् काममोहितः। कस्य त्वेषानवद्याङ्गी यदि वापि न मानुषी॥
en: Possessed by desire he said to the prince named Kotikasya, “Who is this lady of faultless feature? Is she a human being?

sa: ततो राजा तयोः पादावभिवाद्य महात्मनोः। प्रत्याजगाम स्वपुरं धर्मं चैवाचरद् भृशम्॥
en: Then the king, bowing to the feet of the two great-souled beings, returned to his own capital and thenceforward acted most righteously.

sa: सर्वमेतदतिक्रम्य विचार्य च पुनः पुनः। क्षमं यन्नो महाबाहो तद् ब्रवीह्यविचारयन्॥
en: Reviewing in your mind all this and reflecting again and again, speak unhesitatingly what our capabilities are, O you of along arms.

sa: तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति भाषन्तं पृष्ठतो रथपुङ्गवः। पश्यतां सुमहत् कर्म महद् युद्धमुपस्थितम्॥
en: That foremost of charioteers saw him at his back exclaiming "stay, stay, behold a highly great feat-a mighty encounter is at hand."

sa: इदं जितमिदं लब्धमिति श्रुत्वा पराजितान्। द्यूतकाले महाराज स्मयसे स्म कुमारवत्॥
en: Hearing of the defeat (at the game), like a boy you laughed out, O great king, saying-"this is gained, this is won”.

sa: चक्षुषा मनसा वाचा कर्मणा च चतुर्विधम्। प्रसादयति यो लोकं लोकोऽनुप्रसीदति॥
en: Society favours him, who pleases all in four ways viz., by the eyes, by the mind, by words and by the act.

sa: तेषां समुपविष्टानां सर्वेषां पापचेतसाम्। तव मध्यावतरणं मम कृष्ण न रोचते॥
en: The idea does not please me, O Krishna, of your going in the midst of all those of wicked heart seated together.

sa: पलायमानं त्रैगर्त दृष्ट्वा भीमोऽभ्यभाषत। राजपुत्र निवर्तस्व न ते युक्तं पलायनम्॥
en: Beholding the king of Trigarta taking to his heels, Bhima said :"Desist, O prince, it does not behove you to fly away.

sa: स्वानमात्यान् विसृज्याथ विविक्ते तामुवाच सः। केनास्येवं कृता भद्रे मामचिन्त्यावमन्य च॥
en: And dismissing his ministers he asked her in private "O gentle sister, who has made you so by despising and disregarding me?

sa: तस्मै स भगवांस्तुष्टो भ्राता भ्रात्रे धनेश्वरः। सैनापत्यं ददौ धीमान् यक्षराक्षससेनयोः॥
en: Then pleased with his younger brother, the Divine king of wealth, conferred upon him the command of the Yaksha and Rakshasa hosts.

sa: बालेनापि सता मोहाद् भृशं पापकृतान्यपि। नाभ्यासादयितव्यानि तेजांसि च तपांसि च॥
en: Although energy and asceticism destructive of sins, yet even honest persons of tender years, through foolishness ought not to draw them near.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तमब्रवीद् धर्मराजो विहस्य विराटराजं तु भृशाभितप्तम्। बृहन्नला सारथिश्चेन्नरेन्द्र परे न नेष्यन्ति तवाद्य गास्ताः॥
en: Then the king Yudhishthira smilingly said to the king Virata, who was greatly stricken with sorrow. If Brihannala has been his charioteer, the enemies will not be able to take away the kine.

sa: आसाद्य तु कुरुक्षेत्रं व्यूढानीकाः प्रहारिणः। पाण्डवाः समदृश्यन्त नर्दन्तो वृषभा इव॥
en: And having racing Kurukshetra with their army ready for action, those smiters, the Pandavas, looked like bulls wandering about with loud roars.

sa: निःश्वसनग्निवत् तेन संतप्तः स्वेन मन्युना। अप्रशान्तमना भीम सधूम इव पावकः॥
en: With your own worth, your breath is hot like fire and, O Bhima, your mind is not calm like fire with smoke.

sa: पूजयांचक्रिरे शङ्ख कुरवः सहसैनिकाः। अर्जुनेन तथा ध्मातः शतधा यन्न दीर्यते॥
en: Seeing that the conch was not broken into a hundred pieces when blown by Arjuna, the Kuru warriors spoke highly of it.

sa: त्वया रक्षा विधातव्या कृष्णायाः फाल्गुनेन च। विदितं वो यथा सर्वं लोकवृत्तमिदं तव।॥ विदिते चापि वक्तव्यं सुहृद्भिरनुरागतः। एष धर्मश्च कामश्च अर्थश्चैव सनातनः॥ अतोऽहमपि वक्ष्यामि हेतुमत्र निबोधत।
en: You and Falguna (Arjuna) are to protect। Krishna. O kings, the characters of men are properly known to you all. Inspite of your knowledge, it behoves the friends to describe them out of their regard for you and that is reckoned as the everlasting virtue, pleasure and profit. Therefore I shall say something-you should attend.

sa: पार्थोऽपि विश्रुतं लोके गाण्डीवं परमायुधम्। विकृष्य चिक्षेप बहून् नाराचान् मर्मभेदिनः॥
en: And drawing his huge bow Gandiva wellknown in the world Partha too discharged many Narachas capable of piercing into the very vitals.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवमुक्त्वा महाबाहुर्वैराटि नरसत्तमः। अर्जुनो रथिनां श्रेष्ठ उत्तरं वाक्यमब्रवीत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said Having thus addressed the son of Virata, the foremost of men Arjuna the best of carwarriors again said to Uttara.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच इत्युक्ता सिन्धुराजेन वाक्यं हृदयकम्पनम्। कृष्णा तस्मादपाक्रामद् देशात् सभृकुटीमुखी॥
en: Being thus addressed by the king of Sindhu with those heart-rending words, Krishna went away from that place with a frowning face.

sa: एतद्धि कुरवः सर्वे मन्यन्ते धर्मसंहितम्। यत् त्वं प्रशान्ति मन्येथाः पाण्डुपुत्रैर्महात्मभिः॥
en: All the Kurus think this to be in accordance with virtue that you should conclude peace with the high-souled sons of Pandu.

sa: दैवीं मायां रथे युक्तां विहितां विश्वकर्मणा। काञ्चनं सिंहलाङ्गलं ध्वजं वानरलक्षणम्॥
en: He hoisted on his chariot the golden flag having the emblem of a monkey which was a celestials illusion created by Vishvakarman.

sa: पाहि सर्वांश्च लोकांश्च महेन्द्र बलमाप्नुहि। एवं संस्तूयमानश्च सोऽवर्धत शनैः शनैः॥
en: O great Indra, rule over all three worlds and grow in strength. Being thus propitiated he, by slow degrees, increased (in strength).

sa: अक्षौहिण्या च सहितो यज्ञसेनो महाबलः। द्रौपद्याश्च सुता वीराः शिखण्डी चापराजितः॥
en: There came as also the mighty powerful Yajnasena with an Akshauhini of soldiers, the heroic sons of Draupadi and the invincible Shikhandi.

sa: प्रहायोभयमप्येव ज्ञानं कर्म च केवलम्। तृतीयेयं समाख्याता निष्ठा तेन महात्मना॥
en: The great Panchashikha, discarding both the opinion about knowledge and acts, considered the third as the only means or path of Liberation.

sa: तस्य वेदविदः प्राज्ञाः श्रुत्वा तां साधुवृत्तताम्। लोकेषु स्पृहयन्त्यन्ये पुरुषाः पुरुषेश्वर॥
en: Hearing of his good conduct in the world, many wise men, well-conversant with wisdom, O foremost of men, wished to imitate him.

sa: द्रष्टा स्वर्गस्य कोऽन्योऽस्ति तथैव नरकस्य च। आगमांस्त्वनतिक्रम्य दद्याच्चैव यजेत च॥
en: Who else than you will see heaven or hell? Hence, without throwing aside the scriptures, one should make gifts and celebrate sacrifices.

sa: द्रोणश्च शत्शृङ्गश्च चक्रद्वारश्च पर्वतः। मम सत्रेषु पूर्वेषां चिता मघवता सह॥
en: In the sacrifices performed by my ancestors, the foremost of the gods, viz., Indra, used come, accompanied by Drona, Shatashringa, and Chakradvara.

sa: अन्यदेव च क्षेत्रं स्यादन्यः क्षेत्रज्ञ उच्यते। क्षेत्रमव्यक्तमित्युक्तं ज्ञाता वै पञ्चविंशकः॥
en: Kshetra is something quite different from Kshetrajna. Kshetra is Unmanifest. The Soul, which is above the twenty-four principles, is called the Knower.

sa: तत्र रुद्रो महादेवः कर्णिकारमयीं शुभाम्। धारयाणः स्रज भाति ज्योत्स्नामिव निशाकरः॥
en: There Mahadeva, called also Rudra, sat, adorned with an excellent garland of Karnikara flowers, and effulgent like the Moon with his rays.

sa: बिभ्रत् पितुश्च कौरव्य रूपवर्णमनुत्तमम्॥ बभौ तदा भावितात्मा विधूम इव पावकः।
en: Assuming the excellent form and hue of his father, Shuka, O son of Kuru, of purified Soul, shone like a smokeless fire.

sa: अनेन क्रमयोगेन बहुजातिषु कर्मणाम्। हित्वा शुभाशुभं कर्म मोक्षो नामेह लभ्यते॥
en: By renouncing acts, good and bad, according to this order of acts, one succeeds, in course of many births, in acquiring Liberation.

sa: प्रजापतिः प्रजाः पूर्वमसृजत् तपसा विभुः। क्वचित् क्वचिद् ब्रह्मपरो व्रतान्यास्थाय पार्थिव॥
en: It was through penances that the powerful Lord of all creatures, O king, practising vows at particular intervals, created all existent objects.

sa: एतां बुद्धिं समास्थाय जीवितव्यं सदा भवेत्। जीवन् पुण्यमवाप्नोति पुरुषो भद्रमश्नुते॥
en: With such a view one should always preserve his life. person, if alive, can acquire religious merit and enjoy happiness and prosperity.

sa: अपृच्छत् पितरं ब्रह्मन् कुतो वायुरभूदयम्। आख्यातुमर्हति भवान् वायोः सर्वं विचेष्टितम्॥
en: He asked his father saying,-0 twice-born one, whence is this Wind? You should tell me everything about the conduct of the Wind.

sa: अनपत्योऽभवत् प्राणो दुर्धर्षः शत्रुतापनः। पृथक् कर्माणि तेषां ते प्रवक्ष्यामि यथातथम्॥
en: That invincible scorcher of all enemies, vis., Prana, became barren. I shall now recite to you the different functions of those winds.

sa: अदर्शनमसंस्पर्शस्तथासम्भाषणं सदा। यस्य भूतैः सह मुने स श्रेयो विन्दते परम्॥
en: One who never sees others, never touches others, never talks with others, soon, O ascetic, acquires what is for his highest good.

sa: पुंस्त्वोपघातं कालेन दर्शनोपरमं तथा। बाधिर्यं प्राणमन्दत्वं यः पश्यति स मुच्यते॥
en: That man who considers his body as subject to loss of power, weakness of sight, deafness, and loss of strength, is liberated.

sa: यैः कश्चित् सम्मतो लोके गुणैश्च पुरुषो मुने। भवत्यनपगान् सर्वांस्तान् गुणाल्लक्षयामहे॥
en: I see, O Ascetic, those virtues by the possession of which a person is respected in the world, live permanently in you.

sa: तमः सत्त्वं रजति काल: कर्म च भारत॥ गुणैर्नेनीयते बुद्धिर्बुद्धिरेवेन्द्रियाणि च।
en: Sattva, Rajas, Tamas, Time, and Acts, O Bharata, these attributes govern the Understanding. The Understanding is the senses and the five attributes.

sa: शृणु सर्वमिदं दैत्य विष्णोर्माहात्म्यमुत्तमम्। विष्णौ जगत् स्थितं सर्वमिति विद्धि परंतप॥
en: Listen, O Daitya, to everything regarding the greatness of Vishnu. Know, O destroyer of foes, that the entire universe depends on Vishnu.

sa: उशनोवाच नमस्तस्मै भगवते देवाय प्रभविष्णवे। यस्य पृथ्वीतलं तात साकाशं बाहुग्रोचरः॥
en: Ushana said I bow to that divine and illustrious and powerful Being who holds this Earth with the sky in his arms.

sa: भीष्म उवाच प्राप्य श्वेतं महाद्वीपं नारदो भगवानृषिः। ददर्श तानेव नराश्वेतांश्चन्द्रसमप्रभान्॥
en: Bhishma said "Arrived at the spacious kingdom called White Island, the illustrious Rishi saw those same white men effulgent like the sun.

sa: स तु बद्धाञ्जलिं सत्यमयाचद्धरिणः पुनः। सत्येन स परिष्वज्य संदिष्टो गम्यतामिति॥
en: The deer then, with joined hands, again begged of Satya for that. Satya, however, embraced him in friendship and sent him away,-Go!

sa: सुप्रसन्ना हि ते देवा यत्ते धर्मे रता मतिः। धने सुखकला काचिद् धर्मे तु परमं सुखम्॥
en: The gods are truly placed with you since your mind is devoted to virtue. In riches there may be a very little happiness but in virtue the extent of happiness is very great.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच अहो गूढतमः प्रश्नस्त्वया पृष्टो जनेश्वर। नातप्ततपसा ह्येष नावेदविदुषा तथा॥ नापुराणविदा चैव शक्यो व्याहर्तुमञ्जसा।
en: The question you have put to me, O king, relates to a deed mystery. No man can quickly answer it who has not practised penances, and who is not acquainted with the Puranas.

sa: ततोऽथ वरदो देवस्तान् सर्वानमरान् स्थितान्। अशरीरो बभाषेदं वाक्यं खस्थो महेश्वरः॥
en: Thus worshipped by them the boon-giving and great God, invisible and bodiless, addressed those assembled celestials from heaven and said to them

sa: नारद उवाच राजशृणु समाख्यानमद्येदं बहुविस्तरम्। यथावृत्तं श्रुतं चैव मयेदं वसुधाधिप॥
en: Narada said Listen now, O king, to the following long narrative which had taken place. I myself heard it formerly, O king!

sa: अपि वर्णावकृष्टस्तु नारी वा धर्मकाङ्क्षिणी। तावण्येतेन मार्गेण गच्छेतां परमां गतिम्॥
en: By following the path indicated above, even a person of an inferior caste, or a woman, will surely acquire the highest end.

sa: ततः प्रलीने सर्वस्मिन् स्थावरे जङ्गमे तथा। निर्वृक्षा निस्तृणा भूमिदृश्यते कूर्मपृष्ठवत्॥
en: After all mobile and immobile objects have thus disappeared, the Earth, shorn of trees and herbs, looks nude like a tortoise shell.

sa: सुहृदं सर्वभूतानां निर्वैरं शान्तमानसम्॥ दृष्ट्वा त्वां मम संजाता त्वय्यनुक्रोशिनी मतिः।
en: I feel mercy for you, because you are the friend of all creatures, without animosity, and your heart being full of tranquillity.

sa: अत्रैवोदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम्॥ बलिवासवसंवादं पुनरेव युधिष्ठिर।
en: Regarding it is cited the old discourse between Vali and Vasava,OYudhisthira.

sa: प्रह्लाद उवाच प्रवृत्तिं च निवृत्तिं च भूतानां यो न बुद्ध्यते। तस्य स्तम्भो भवेद् बाल्यानास्ति स्तम्भोऽनुपश्यतः।।१४।
en: Prahlada said “He who does not know the origin and the destruction of all created objects, is, on account of such ignorance, stupefied. He, however, who knows these two things, is never stupefied.

sa: तामथौघवतीं राजन् स पावकसुतोऽब्रवीत्। अतिथेः प्रतिकूलं ते न कर्तव्यं कथंचन॥
en: The son of Agni, O king, said to Oghavati Do you never act against the wishes of those who seek our hospitality.

sa: ततो विहस्य विप्रर्षिः सा चैवाथ विवेश ह। संस्मृत्य भर्तुर्वचनं गृहस्थाश्रमकाङ्क्षिणः॥
en: Recollecting the words of her husband who was desirous of acquiring the virtue of householders, she cheerfully approached the i twiceborn Rishi.

sa: ततो नादः समभवद् दिक्षु सर्वासु भारत। असकृत् सत्यमित्येवं नैतन्मिथ्येति सर्वतः॥
en: At this, O Bharata, there arose from all sides, in repeated echoes, a voice, crying This is true, this is not false.

sa: स्थाने मतङ्गा ब्राह्मण्यं नालभद् भरतर्षभ। चण्डालयोनौ जातो हि कथं ब्राह्मण्यमाप्तवान्॥
en: Matanga was born as a Chandala, and could not acquire Brahmanahood, but how could this man acquire the status of a Brahmana?

sa: तत्र पञ्चशिखो नाम कापिलेयो महामुनिः। परिधावन महीं कृत्स्नां जगाम मिथिलामथ॥
en: Once upon a time a great ascetic named Panchashikha the son of Kapila, having roamed over the whole world, arrived at Mithila.

sa: स्थाने मतङ्गा ब्राह्मण्यं नालभद् भरतर्षभ। चण्डालयोनौ जातो हि कथं ब्राह्मण्यमाप्तवान्॥
en: Matanga was born as a Chandala, and could not acquire Brahmanahood, but how could this man acquire the status of a Brahmana?

sa: स तुतोष च ब्रह्मर्षिस्तस्या वृत्तेन भारत। छन्दयामास चैवैनां वरेण वरवर्णिनीम्॥
en: That foremost of twiceborn Rishis, O Bharata, was well pleased with her conduct and expressed a desire to grant her a boon.

sa: तथा स्वर्गश्च भोगश्च निष्ठा या च मनीषिता। सर्वं पुरुषकारेण कृतेनेहोपलभ्यते॥
en: One attains to heaven, and all the object of enjoyment, as also the fulfilment of his heart's desires, by wellapplied personal Exertion.

sa: दानवेन्द्रा महाकाया महावीर्यबलोच्छ्रिताः। नाशक्नुवंश्च किंचित् ते तस्य कर्तुं तदा विभो॥
en: Those foremost of Danavas, of huge bodies, endued with mighty energy, swelling with strength, O monarch, could do nothing to that Boar.

sa: नोत्सहन्ते यथा वेत्तुमिन्द्रियैरिन्द्रियाण्यपि। तथैवेह परा बुद्धिः परं बोध्यं न पश्यति।१४॥
en: People cannot, through their senses, know : the senses. Likewisc mere Intelligence at its highest cannot see the Soul which is supreme.

sa: यदि तावन्न गृह्णामि ब्राह्मणेनापवर्जितम्। कथं न लिप्येयमहं पापेन महताद्य वै॥
en: If I do not take what has been given by this Brahmana, how shall I avoid being polluted with a great sin?

sa: स्वयमेव मनश्चैवं पञ्चवर्गं च भारत। पूर्वं ध्यानपथे स्थाप्य नित्ययोगेन शाम्यति॥
en: One succeeds, O Bharata, by directing one's mind and to the path of senses meditation, in controlling them perfectly by steadfast Yoga.

sa: इन्द्रियाणि च सर्वाणि विजेतव्यानि धीमता॥ सत्त्वं रजस्तमश्चैव प्राणिनां संश्रिताः सदा।
en: An intelligent man should control all his senses. The three qualities of Goodness, Darkness and Ignorance are always attached to living creatures.

sa: शक्र उवाच कः पुनर्भवने हेतुरीशे कारणकारणे। येन शर्वादृतेऽन्यस्मात् प्रसादं नाभिकाक्षसि॥
en: Shakra said What are your grounds for the existence of a Supreme Being or for His being the cause of all causes?

sa: स्वेदमूत्रपुरीषाणि श्लेष्मा पित्तं सशोणितम्। तनुः क्षरति सर्वेषां कस्माद् वर्णो विभज्यते॥
en: The bodies of all men sweat and puss urine, faeces, phlegm, bile and blood. How then can men be divided into classes?

sa: आत्मानं तं विजानीहि सर्वलोकहितात्मकम्। तस्मिन् यः संश्रितो देहे ह्यब्विन्दुरिव पुष्करें।२४॥
en: Know that Soul. He is full of universal benevolence. He lives in the body like a drop of water in a lotus.

sa: स्कन्दो मयूरमास्थाय स्थितो देव्याः समीपतः। शक्तिघण्टे समादाय द्वितीय इव पावकः॥
en: Near the goddess Uma was Skanda seated on his peacock, bearing his dreadful arrow and bells, and loO king like another Fire-God.

sa: स परित्यज्य शाखाश्च पत्राणि कुसुमानि च। प्रभाते वायुमायान्तं प्रत्यक्षत वनस्पतिः॥
en: Casting off his branches, leaves and flowers, in the morning the tree looked firmly at the Wind as he came towards him.

sa: सदैव शकुनास्तात मृगाश्चाथ तथा गजाः। वसन्ति तव संहृष्टा मनोहर मनोहराः॥
en: O charming tree, beautiful birds of various kinds, and elephants and other animals gladly live on your branches and under their shade.

sa: अद्य शोकं विजानामि मानुषाणां महीतले। स्नेहं हि कारणं कृत्वा ममाप्यश्रूण्यथापतन्॥
en: To-day, however, I perceive the extent of grief of human beings on earth. Seeing their great affection I had shed tears myself.

sa: स तान् प्रत्यर्चयामास राक्षसान् भीमविक्रमान्। निवेदयत मां क्षिप्रं धनदायेति चाब्रवीत्॥
en: The Rishi adored in return those Rakshasas of terrible prowess and asked them report, forthwith his arrival to the Lord of Rishis.

sa: भीष्म उवाच एवमुक्त्वा तु राजानमिन्द्रोतो जनमेजयम्। याजयामास विधिवद् वाजिमेधेन शौनकः॥
en: Bhishma said Having said these words to king Janamejaya, Indrota, the son of Shaunaka, assisted him in the celebration of the Horsesacrifice.

sa: सहस्रे किल नारीणां प्राप्येतैका कदाचन॥ तथा शतसहस्रेषु यदि काचित् पतिव्रता।
en: Among a thousand women, or perhaps, among hundreds of thousands, sometimes only one may be found who is devoted to her husband.

sa: शुभं कर्म परित्यज्य सोऽहं शकुनिलुब्धकः। नृशंसस्य ममाद्यायं प्रत्यादेशो न संशयः॥ दत्तः स्वमांसं दहता कपोतेन महात्मना।
en: Alas, renouncing all sorts of honourable occupation, I have become a fowler! A cruel wretch that I am, forsooth, this noble pigeon, by sacrificing his own life, has taught me a great lesson.

sa: भीष्म उवाच अथ वृक्षस्य शाखायां विहङ्गः ससुहज्जनः। दीर्घकालोषितो राजंस्तत्र चित्रतनूरुहः॥
en: In one of the branches of that tree, a pigeon having beautiful feather, o king, lived for many years with his family.

sa: विहीनं कर्मणान्यायं यः प्रगृह्णाति भूमिपः। उपायस्याविशेषज्ञं तद् वै क्षत्रं नपुंसकम्॥
en: That Kshatriya who, innocent of the established customs and contrivances, improperly taxes his people, is considered as a eunuch of his order.

sa: स विनद्य महानादमभीषून् संनियम्य च। ननर्त हर्षसंवीतो वातोद्भूत इव दुमः॥
en: Indeed uttering loud shouts he then embraced the son of Pandu. Thus uttering loud roars and drawing the reins of the steeds.

sa: बभौ बलं तद्विमुक्तं पादबन्धाद् विशाम्पते। मेघवृन्दाद् यथा मुक्तो भास्करस्तापयन् प्रजाः॥
en: Freed from that foot-trapping weapon the Samsaptakas, O monarch, looked like the sun giving rays unto all creatures when freed from clouds.

sa: चतुश्चक्रा द्विचक्राश्च शतघ्यो बहुला गदाः। चक्राणि च क्षुरान्तानि मण्डलानीव भास्वतः॥
en: Shataghnis of four or two wheels and a large number of maces and sharp-edged discs, effulgent like the sun also appeared there.

sa: तत् तु पार्थस्य विक्रान्तं वासुदेवस्य चोभयोः। अपूजयन् महाराज कौरवा महदद्भुतम्॥
en: During that fight, O mighty kings, even the Kurus themselves applauded the prowess displayed by Arjuna and the son of Vasudeva. course

sa: ततोऽन्यद् धनुरादाय तव पुत्रः प्रतापवान्॥ तिष्ठ तिष्ठेति राजानं ब्रुवन् पाण्डवमभ्ययात्।
en: Thereafter your highly puissant Duryodhana taking up another bow and addressing king Yudhishthira saying "wait wait" rushed against that son of Pandu.

sa: तथैव तान् प्रत्यविध्यत् कुन्तीपुत्रो धनंजयः। द्रोणपुत्रं चतुःषष्ट्या मद्रराजं शतेन च॥
en: Dhananjaya, the son of Kunti then in return pierced Drona's son with sixty-four and the ling of the Madras while hundred arrows.

sa: मद्रकेषु न संसृष्टं शौचं गान्धारकेषु च॥ राजयाजकयाज्ये च नष्टं दत्तं हरिभवेत्। शूद्रसंस्कारको विप्रो यथा याति पराभवम्॥ यथा ब्रह्मद्विषो नित्यं गच्छन्तीह पराभवम्। यथैव संगतं कृत्वा नरः पतति मद्रकैः॥ मद्रके संगतं नास्ति हतं वृश्चिक ते विषम्। आथर्वणेन मन्त्रेण यथा शान्तिः कृता मया।॥
en: Friendship is lost on a Madraka as purity in Gandharakas and as oblation offered in a sacrifice where the king is both the sacrificer and the priest. As a Brahmana performing the initiation ceremony of a Sudra meets with deterioration as one who hates a Brahmana, meets with deterioration so a person, forming alliance with a Madraka, is deteriorated. As there is no friendship in a Madraka, so is your poison is powerless, O Scorpion; with this Mantra of Atharvan I have duly performed the ceremony of peace.

sa: स सात्यकेस्तु बलिनः कर्णस्य च महात्मनः। आसीत् समागमो राजन् बलिवासवयोरिव॥
en: Him, O mighty monarch, Satyaki pierced in return with ten shafts before the eyes of all the heroes present and said-'Fly not-stay.'

sa: तत्र राजन् महानासीत् संग्रामो लोमहर्षणः॥ पाण्डवानां महाबाहो तावकानां च संयुगे।
en: Thereupon, O king, there commenced a awful combat making the hair stand erect between the Pandavas and your troops, O mighty-armed one.

sa: सात्वतोऽपि रणे क्रुद्धः सोमदत्तस्य धन्विनः। धनुचिच्छेद भल्लेन क्षुरप्रेण शितेन ह॥
en: Filled with wrath, Satyaki also, in that engagement, cut-off with a keen and razorfaced shaft, the bow of the (great) bowman Somadatta.

sa: अलायुधस्य योधांश्च राक्षसान् भीमदर्शनान्। वेगेनापततः शूरान् प्रगृहीतशरासनान्॥ आत्तायुधः सुसंक्रुद्धो युयुधानो महारथः। नकुलः सहदेवश्च चिच्छिदुर्निशितैः शरैः॥
en: Meanwhile the mighty car-warriors Yuyudhana, Nakula and Sahadeva began to pierce with keen shafts the warriors of Alayudha, viz., those grim looking heroic Rakshasas, who, wielding there bows, were rushing impetuously against them.

sa: स द्रोणं पञ्चभिर्विद्ध्वा शरैः संनतपर्वभिः। ध्वजमेकेन विव्याध सारथिं चास्य सप्तभिः॥
en: Piercing Drona with five shafts of depressed knots, he cut down his standard with one and wounded his charioteer with seven shafts.

sa: श्रीवासुदेव उवाच दुःशासनश्च कर्णश्च शकुनिश्च ससैन्धवः। सततं मन्त्रयन्ति स्म दुर्योधनपुरोगमाः॥
en: Vasudeva said Dushasana, Karna, Sakuni the ruler of the Sindhus with Duryodhana at their head, had frequently held consultation about this subject.

sa: ततो भूरिश्रवाः क्रुद्धः सात्यकिं युद्धदुर्मदः। उद्यम्याभ्याहनद् राजन् मत्तो मत्तमित द्विपम्॥
en: Then the indomitable Bhurisravas inflamed with rage, uplifting his sword struck Satyaki like a mad elephant striking another in the same state.

sa: द्रष्टासि ध्रुवमद्यैव विधवाः कर्णयोषितः। न हि मे शाम्यते मन्युर्यदनेन पुरा कृतम्॥ कृष्णां सभागता दृष्टरा मूढेनादीर्धदर्शिना। अस्मांस्तथावहसता क्षिपता च पुनः पुनः॥
en: Surely you will today see Karna's wives will become widows. I cannot check my rage when I think of evils done to us by this (thoughtless) fool when Krishna was taken forcibly before the assembly and he used abusive language to us and laughed.

sa: अद्य धर्मसुतो राजा दृष्ट्वा मम पराक्रमम्॥ अश्वत्थाममयं लोकं मंस्यते सह
en: Witnessing my prowess today, king (Yudhishthira), the son of Dharma, together with the Somakas, will deem the whole world full of Ashvatthamas.

sa: भ्रातरं निहतं दृष्ट्वा समरे सव्यसाचिना। पश्यतां कुरुवीराणां प्रथमं त्वं पलायितः॥
en: Seeing your brother killed by Savya Sachin in the very presence of the Kuru heroes it was you who fled away first.

sa: दग्ध्वा योधाञ्छरैर्वीरो भारद्वाजः प्रतापवान्॥ धृष्टद्युम्नं समासाद्य स गतः परमां गतिम्।
en: Having with his arrows killed numerous warriors that valiant and chivalrous son of Bharadvaja, at last attained highest and on encountering Dhristadyumna.

sa: सुदान्तानपि चैवाहं दद्यामष्टादशापरान्। रथं च शुभ्रं सौवर्णं दद्यां तस्मै स्वलंकृतम्॥ युक्तं परमकाम्बोजैर्यो मे ब्रूयाद् धनंजयम्।
en: I shall also give him eighteen other tame horses. I shall give him, who will point out Arjuna to me, a golden car adorned with various ornaments and drawn by best Kamboja horses.

sa: असौ निघ्नन् रथोदारानर्जुनः शरवृष्टिभिः॥ सर्वा ग्रसति नः सेनां कर्ण पश्यैनमाहवे।
en: Behold O Karna, having slain all our carwarriors in battle with a net work of arrows, Arjuna is devouring our entire army.

sa: नाकुलिचित्रसेनं तु विद्ध्वा पञ्चभिराशुगैः। स तु तं प्रतिविव्याध दशभिर्निशितैः शरैः॥
en: The son of Nakula pierced Chitrasena, with five arrows. He (i.e. Citrasena) also pierced him i.e. in return with ten sharpened arrows.

sa: ततो बाणमयं जालं विततं व्योम्नि दृश्यते। खद्योतानामिव वातैः संपतद्भिर्यथा नभः॥
en: Then that net-work of arrows, spread over the sky, looked like the firmament, covered over with innumerable fire-flies, that roved about it.

sa: फाल्गुनं प्रति दुर्धर्षः क्रोधात् संरक्तलोचनः॥ तं प्रयान्तं महाबाहुं दृष्ट्वा शारद्वतस्तदा।
en: Furiously with his eyes reddened in wrath, against Phalguni. Seeing that mighty-armed one advance (against Arjuna), the son of Saradvatta (i.e. Kripa).

sa: मल्लयुद्धं मया सार्ध कुरु दुष्कुलसम्भव। महाबलो महाभोगी कीचको निहतो यथा॥
en: O scion of a mean family, come and wrestle with me. Then even as I have slain the mighty and luxurious Kichaka.

sa: प्रताप्यमानं सूर्येण भीमेन च महात्मना। तव सैन्यं संचुकोच चर्माग्नावाहितं यथा॥
en: Scorched by the sun and the high-souled Bhima your army began to shrink like a piece of leather spread over a fire.

sa: न च कर्णं रणे शक्ता जेतुमन्ये महारथाः। कर्ण वीर्यवन्तं पराक्रमे॥
en: O Janardana, You are well aware of Karna's energy and prowess. No other warrior of our army is capable of conquering Karna.

sa: दीपयन्ती उभे सेने शंसन्तीव महद् भयम्। जज्वलुश्चैव शस्त्राणि भारद्वाजस्य मारिष॥
en: In their fall they illumined the welkin and foreboded great danger. O sire, the weapons of Bharadvaja's son began to blaze forth.

sa: सोऽतिविद्धो बलवता तव पुत्रेण धन्विना। विरराज महाबाहुः सशृङ्ग इव पर्वतः॥
en: Pierced deeply by that powerful bcwman, that is, your son, Prativindhya, O mighty monarch, looked like a mountain furnished with a peak.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच दुर्योधनमतिक्रान्तमेतं पश्य धनंजय। अत्यद्भुतमिमं मन्ये नास्त्यस्य सदृशो रथः॥
en: Vasudeva said O Dhananjaya, behold, Suyodhana has outrun Meseems this to be highly wonderful. There is indeed no car-warrior equal to him.

sa: सोमदत्तस्तु तं षष्ट्या विव्याघोरसि माधवम्। सात्यकिश्चापि तं राजन्नविध्यत् सायकैः शितैः॥
en: Somadatta also pierced the descendant of Madhu in the chest with sixty arrows. Satyaki, too, O king, pierced him with keen darts.

sa: ततः कर्णो महाराज आशीविष इव श्वसन्॥ शरवर्षेण महता छादयामास पाण्डवम्।
en: Then sighing like a serpent of deadly venom, O king, Karna covered the son of Pandu with a thick shower of arrows.

sa: पृथवीं चान्तरिक्षं च कम्पयन् सागरानपि। एतद् बलार्णवं सूत वारयिष्ये महारणे॥
en: And causing the earth, the conclave dome and occans to tremble. O Suta, this ocean like host I shall resist in battle.

sa: ततो विस्फार्य बलवद् गाण्डीवं जनिवान् रिपून्। महता शरवर्षेण तलशब्देन चार्जुनः॥
en: Then stretching his toughest bow Gandiva, Arjuna went on slaughtering his foes, shooting arrowy showers and producing loud din with his palm-strokes.

sa: सैनिका न्यपतन्नुर्व्या वातुनुन्ना इव दुमाः॥ तेषु तूत्साद्यमानेषु फाल्गुनेन महात्मना। सम्प्राद्रवद् बलं सर्वं पुत्राणां ते विशाम्पते॥
en: The soldiers fell down like trees levelled (on the ground) by a storm. Thus slaughtered by that renowned Pandava all the soldiers (of your son) ran away like a terror-stricken herd of deer.

sa: तथा तु स्तिमितं दृष्ट्वा गतसत्त्वमवस्थितम्। बलं तव महाराज राजा दुर्योधनोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: O great monarch, seeing your force (his own troops) thus eclipsed (by that of the Pandavas) and standing as if lifeless, king

sa: दुरात्मा मद्रको नित्यं नित्यमानृतिकोऽनृजुः। यावदन्त्यं हि दौरात्म्यं मद्रकेष्विति नः श्रुतम्॥
en: The Madraka is always wicked, untruthful and crooked. We have heard that the Madrakas are wicked till the hour of their death.

sa: कर्ण पश्य सुदुर्बुद्धे तिष्ठेदानी नराधमा एष तेऽद्य शिरः कायादुद्धरामि सुदुर्मते॥
en: Look, O Karna of wicked understanding, O vilest of men stay here now. I will presently cut-off your head from your body.

sa: पाञ्चजन्यं च बलवान् दध्मौ तारेण केशवः। रजसा ध्वस्तपक्ष्मान्तः प्रस्विन्नवदनो भृशम्॥
en: Then the mighty Keshava loudly blew his conch Panchajanya, with his eye lashes covered with dust and countenance shedding drops of perspiration.

sa: स धैर्ययुक्तं प्रसमीक्ष्य मां वै न त्वं विप्रः कोऽसि सत्यं वदेति। दाख्यातवान् सूत इत्येव शल्य॥
en: O Shalya, Beholding my patience he said-"you are never a Brahmana. Tell me truly who you are." I then gave him the true information about myself and said that I was a Suta.

sa: तस्यान्तमिषुभी राजन् यदा द्रौणिर्न जग्मिरान्॥ अथ त्यक्त्वा धनुर्वीरः पार्षतं त्वरितोऽन्वगात्।
en: O king, when the son of Drona could not kill him with arrows, that hero, laying aside his bow, quickly followed Parshata.

sa: उपदेक्ष्याम्युपायं ते येन ते प्रसहिष्यसि। सुयोधनं चापि रणे हनिष्यति वृकोदरः॥
en: I shall tell you the means through which you shall be able to slay Karna. Vrikodara also will slay Suyodhana in battle.

sa: शरान्धकारे तु माहत्मभिः कुते महामृधे योधवरैः परस्परम्। चतुर्दिशो वै विदिशश्च पार्थिव प्रभा च सूर्यस्य तमोवृताभवत्॥
en: In fact, those brave and picked warriors sent out such hosts of shots against one another that the light of the sun became almost indistinct and the very atmosphere was filled with darkness.

sa: इत्युक्तो रथमास्थाय तथेति प्राह भारत। शल्येऽभ्युपगते कर्णः सारथिं सुमनाऽब्रवीत्॥ त्वं सूत स्यादनं मह्यं कल्पयेत्यसकृत् त्वरन्।
en: Thus addressed he expressed his consent and got upon the chariot, O Bharata. When Shalya went there, Karna, in good spirits, addressed his driver saying, O charioteer, quickly equip this car for me.

sa: दीर्यमाणं बलं दृष्ट्वा युयुधानशराहतम्। श्रुत्वा च विपुलं नादं निशीथे लोमहर्षणे॥
en: Beholding the army routed and afflicted by the arrows of Yuyudhana and hearing in that nightly darkness that tremendous and horripilating uproar.

sa: विचित्रान् पृतनामध्ये रथमार्गानुदीर्य तौ। अन्योन्यमपसव्यं च कर्तुं वीरौ तदेषतुः।। :॥
en: Then those two heroes, displaying various motions of cars on the field of battle, tried to leave each other to their right.

sa: अर्जुनं च युधां श्रेष्ठं प्राद्रवन्तं महारथम्। अलम्बुषो महाराज राक्षसेन्द्रो न्यवारयत्॥
en: O great king, Alambusha, the lord of the Rakshasas, resisted the rapid career of the mighty car-warrior Arjuna, the foremost of warriors.

sa: त्वरितो वीर गच्छ त्वं गान्धार्युदरमाविश॥ पृथिव्यां धावमानस्य नान्यत् पश्यामि जीवनम्। यदि तावत् कृता बुद्धिः पलायणपरायणा॥
en: O brave warrior! Go immediately and reenter in the ovary of Gandhari, your mother. Because, there is o other place on this earth capable to defend you if you depart from the battle-field.

sa: हृदयं तस्य भित्त्वा च जगाम वसुधातलम्। कश्मलं प्राविशद् राजा वृषसेनशराहतः॥
en: (That dart) riving his heart penetrated into the earth. The king (Drupada), thus wounded by Vrishasena, with dart, fell into a swoon.

sa: अथान्यद् धनुरादाय पुत्रस्तव जनेश्वर॥ सात्यकिं च शरैर्विद्ध्वा सिंहनादं ननर्द ह।
en: O ruler of men, then your son taking up another bow pierced Satyaki with his arrows and then uttered a loud war-cry.

sa: ततः पार्थो महेष्वासो दृष्ट्वा कर्णस्य विक्रमम्॥ मुष्टिदेशे धनुस्तस्य चिच्छेद त्वरयान्वितः।
en: Then that mighty bowman Partha, witnessing the prowess of Karna, speedily cutoff that part of his bow at which it is grasped.

sa: तथा त्वां घातयिष्यामि पश्यत्सु सर्वराजसु। भीमस्य मतमाज्ञाया कर्णो बुद्धिमतां वरः॥
en: I will slay you before the very eyes of all the kings. “But knowing Bhima's intention, that foremost of intelligent beings Karna.

sa: यास्ता विजयतश्चापि विदुरस्य महात्मनः। धीरस्य वाचो नाश्रौषीः क्षेमाय वदतः शिवाः॥
en: You did not then pay heed to those auspicious words, which the magnanimous wise Vidura with tearful eyes said for your good.

sa: सा तु सम्प्राप्य विश्रामं ध्वजिनी तव भारत। सुखमाप्तवती वीरमर्जुनं प्रत्यपूजयत्॥
en: Then that army of yours, O Bharata, joyful at the prespect of sleep and rest, sincerely blessed Arjuna sayingत्वयि वेदास्तथास्राणि त्वयि बुद्धिपराक्रमौ।

sa: अस्यता येन संग्रामे धरण्यभिनिपीडिता। यो न व्यथति संग्रामे वीरः सत्यपराक्रमः॥
en: Shooting his arrows in battle he had afflicted the earth herself. Brave and of great prowess, he is never exhausted in battle.

sa: नकुलः सहदेवश्च शरौघान् विसृजन्तस्ते प्रेरयन्तश्च तोमरान्॥ न शेकुर्यनवन्तोऽपि राधेयं प्रतिवीक्षितुम्।
en: Although making a downpour of arrows, discharging Tomaras and exerting their very best they could not look at the son of Radha.

sa: द्वाभ्यां द्वाभ्यां यमौ सार्धं रथाभ्यां रथपुङ्गवौ। समासक्तौ ततो द्रोणं धृष्टद्युम्नोऽभ्यवर्तत॥
en: Each of the twins, both mighty car-warriors was engaged with a couple of opponents. Meanwhile Dhristadyumna poured showers of arrows on Drona.

sa: पश्यतां ते महाराज पुत्राणां चित्रयोधिनाम्। शकुनेः सौबलेयस्य कर्णस्य च विशाम्पते॥
en: Thereupon in the very presence of your sons, O king, conversant with diverse modes of war-fare, of Subala's son Shakuni and Karna.

sa: कृतवर्मा तु हार्दिक्यो युधिष्ठिरमुपाद्रवत्। द्रोणं प्रति समायान्तं मत्तो मत्तमिव द्विपम्॥
en: Kritavarman, the son of Hridika, rushed against Yudhishthira as he was advancing against Drona like a mad elephant against its infuriate rival.

sa: तस्मै त्वं विसृजेयं वै स त्वां रक्षेद् यथार्जुनः। कुरु त्वमात्मनो गुप्ति कस्ते गोप्ता गते मयि॥
en: I could have made you over to his protection and he could have protected, you like Arjuna himself. You should look after your own protection. Who shall protect you when I am gone?

sa: एवमुक्त्वा तु तं कृष्णो रथाद् भूमिमवर्तयत्। निःश्वसन्तं यथा नागं क्रोधसंरक्तलोचनम्॥
en: Having thus spoken, Krishna dragged him down on the earth, him who was breathing like a snake with eyes coppery with rage.

sa: ततो दुन्दुभिनिर्घोषो मृदङ्गानां च सर्वशः। सिंहनादः सवादिनः कुञ्जराणां च निःस्वनः॥ प्रादुरासीत् तदा राजन् सैन्येषु पुरुषर्षभ। योधानां सम्प्रहृष्टानां तथा समभवत् स्वनः॥
en: Then there arose in the midst of the army, O king, O foremost, of men, the beat of cymbals and druirs, leonine roars of the elephants and the sounds of the various musical instruments as well as war-cries of the heroes filled with joy.

sa: तस्मिन् स्थिते महाराज रुद्रे विधृतकार्मुके॥ पुराणि तानि कालेन जग्मुरेवैकतां तदा।
en: O most powerful monarch, while Rudra was thus standing, grasping his bow, then by that time, those three cities became united together.

sa: तत: सुपर्णाः सम्पेतुर्भक्षयन्तो भुजङ्गमान्। ते वै विदुद्रुवुर्नागा दृष्ट्वा तान् खचरानृप॥
en: Then numerous vultures began to come down and devour snakes. Then, O king, beholding those birds the serpents began to fly away.

sa: पार्वतश्च ससोदर्यः पार्थिवाश्च महाबलाः। द्रौपदेयाश्च मां तात रक्षिष्यन्ति न संशयः॥
en: The son of Prisata with his uterine brothers, these mighty kings and the sons of Draupadi, O sire, will certainly, protect me.

sa: आपद्गतं कश्चन यो विमोक्षेत् स बान्धवः स्नेहयुक्तः सुहृच। एवं पुराणा मुनयो वदन्ति धर्मः सदा सद्भिरनुष्टितश्च॥
en: Our ancient sages have stated that sibling is the man who defends the man from adversity befallen and he is real friend also. This is the everlasting deed (religion) observed by the gentlemen.

sa: स वै क्रुद्धः सिंह इवात्यमर्षी नामर्षयत् प्रतिघातं रणेऽसौ। शक्तिं श्रेष्ठां वैजयन्तीमसह्यां समाददे तस्य वधं चिकीर्षन्॥
en: Burning with wrath like an infuriate lion and unable to brook the assaults of the Rakshasa Karna took up that foremost of victory-giving and indomitable darts, desirous of achieving the destruction of Ghatotkacha.

sa: अद्याभिमन्योः शत्रूणां सर्वेषां मधुसूदन॥ प्रमथिष्यामि गात्राणि शिरांसि च शितैः शरैः।
en: O Madhusudana, with sharp-pointed arrows, I will, today, striking down all the enemies of Abhimanyu dissever their heads and disjoint their body.'

sa: शरैः पञ्चाशता वीरः फाल्गुनं प्रत्यविध्यता तस्य तल्लाघ्वं दृष्ट्वा नामृष्यत रणेऽर्जुनः॥
en: Pierced the heroic Phalguna in return with fifty arrows. Beholding that lightness of hands displayed by him, Arjuna did not throok him.

sa: ततस्तु सात्वतस्यार्थे भीमसेनो नवं दृढम्। मुमोच परिघं घोरं सोमदत्तस्य वक्षसि॥
en: Thereupon Satyaki, excited with wrath, discharged at the chest of Somadaita. a new, strong and formidable Parigha furnished with a golden handle.

sa: तदुग्रमतिरौद्रं च दृष्ट्वा युद्धं नराधिपाः। तनयास्तव कर्णश्च व्यथिताः प्राद्रवन् दिशः॥
en: Seeing that furious and terrible battle the kings, your sons and Karna too, being (greatly) distressed, ran away from the battle field).

sa: एते द्रवन्ति रथिनस्त्वदीयाः पाण्डुनन्दन। पश्य पश्य यथा पार्थ गच्छन्त्येते महारथाः॥
en: The car-warriors of your army, O son of Pandu, are flying away. See, O Partha, how they are taking to their heels.

sa: ते वध्यामानाः कर्णेन पाण्डवेयास्ततस्ततः॥ प्राद्रवन्त रणे भीताः कर्ण दृष्ट्वा महारथम्।
en: Thus beaten by that foremost of carwarriors, Karna, the Pandava troops began to flee in all directions-afraid to face him in battle.

sa: पाण्डवास्तु जयं लब्वा तव सैन्यं समाद्रवन्। समन्तान्निशितान् बाणान् विमुञ्चन्तो जयैषिणः॥
en: Having thus accomplished victory the Pandavas, desirous of achieving (further) success, pursued your soldiers, on all sides, making a discharge of arrows.

sa: त एनमब्रुवन् सर्वे द्रोणमाहवशोभिनम्। अधर्मतः कृतं युद्धं समयो निधनस्य ते॥
en: All these then addressed Drona, that ornament of battle, into these words-'You are fighting wrongly, the hour of your death has come.

sa: प्रयाहि वृद्धिं च दिशन्तु देवता यथाहमिच्छामि तवास्तु तत् तथा। प्रयाहि शीघ्रं जहि कर्णमाहवे पुरंदरो वृत्रमिवात्मवृद्धये॥
en: May the gods grant you prosperity! May you realise all that I wish of you! At present go at once to the battle and kill Karna for selfelevation even as Purandara killed Vritra.

sa: भूरिश्रवास्तु संक्रुद्धः प्रतोदं चिच्छिदे हरेः॥ अर्जुनं च त्रिसप्तत्या बाणानामाजघान ह॥
en: Bhurishrava then inflamed with rage, cutoff the whip that Hari held and he then pierced Arjuna with a group of seventy-three arrows.

sa: प्रतिलभ्यं तत: संज्ञां योधास्ते कुरुसत्तम॥ अर्जुनं सिषिचुर्बाणैः पर्वतं जलदा इव।
en: Then regaining their consciousness, O foremost of Kurus, your soldiers made a downpour of arrows on Arjuna like clouds on a mountain.

sa: तं तु दुःशासनः शूरः सायकैरावृणोद् भृशम्। रथावातेन महता नानादेशोद्भवेन च॥
en: Then that foremost of the Bharatas surrounded Satyaki with a mighty division of car-warriors born in various realms; he shot numerous arrows.

sa: तावन्ये धनुषी श्रेष्ठे शक्रचापनिभे शुभे। प्रगृह्य रेजतुः शूरौ देवपुत्रसौ युधि॥
en: Each of them, taking up two beautiful bows resembling those of Indra's looked very graceful like two celestial youths in the battlefield.

sa: मन्युवीर्यबलोपेतं दर्पात् प्रत्यवरोपितम्। अभवत् तव पुत्रस्य तत् सैन्यं निष्प्रभं तदा॥
en: The army of your son, however powerful and energetic it might have been, lost all its glory and pride at that time.

sa: केशवस्तु ततो बाहू विधुन्वन् रणमूर्धनि॥ पातयामास तान् सर्वान् दुष्टहस्तीव हस्तिपान्।
en: Then shaking his arms on the field of battle Keshava struck down all of them like an elephant assailing other leading elephants.

sa: घटोत्कचस्तु तद्धत्वा रक्षो बलवतां वरम्। मुमोच बलचन्नादं बलं हत्वेव वासवः॥
en: That best of all beings possessed of might viz., the Rakshasa Ghatotkacha, slaying Alambusha like Vasava laying Bala, uttered by loud roars.

sa: न्यायच्छन्तो हताः शूरो मदर्थे येऽपराङ्मुखाः। यतमानाः परं शक्त्या विजेतुमहितान् मम॥
en: Those unretreating warriors after exerting their utmost to vanquish my enemies and fighting for my sake have (at last) sacrificed their lives.

sa: मया कर्णस्यास्त्रमिदं पुरस्ताद् युद्धे दृष्टं पाण्डव चित्ररूपम्॥ न ह्यन्ययोद्धा विद्यते सृञ्जायानां महारथं योऽद्य सहेत कर्णम्।
en: O son of Pandu, I saw Karna's wonderful weapon being carried in front of the army. Methinks there is none amongst the Srinjayas who will be able to withstand the mighty carwarrior Karna.

sa: यस्य राजन् गजानीकं बहु साहस्त्रमद्भुतम्। सुदक्षिणः स संग्रामे निहत: सव्यसाचिना॥
en: O monarch, that Sudakshina, who had under him several thousands of extra-ordinary warriors fighting on elephants, was slain in battle by Savyasachin.

sa: तदिदं द्यूतमारब्धं पुनरेव यथा पुरा॥ विषमं शकुंनेश्चैव तव चैव विशाम्पते।
en: You have, therefore, once more given preference to a game of chance as that one formerly between yourself and Shakuni, O monarch.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच धनंजयोत्सुकानां तु भ्रातृणां कृष्णया सह। श्रुत्वा वाक्यानि विमनाधर्मराजोऽप्यजायत्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having heard these words of his brothers and Krishna (Draupadi) who were all anxious for Dhananjaya, Dharmaraja became absentminded.

sa: रक्ताभ्यां नयनाभ्यां तु भयमुत्पादयन्निव। धूमं च ज्वलयल्ल्क्ष्म्या तत्र देशे व्यवर्धत॥
en: Causing terror with his red eyes and ernitting smokes from his blazing lustre, he began to swell in magnitude in that place.

sa: यत् तच्छतसहस्रेण सम्मितं राष्ट्रवर्द्धनम्। येन देवान् मनुष्यांश्च पार्थो विजयते मृधे॥
en: It is equal to a hundred thousand bows and capable of extending kingdoms: by this Partha defeated in battle celestials and men.

sa: ये त्विमे भास्कराकाराः सर्वपारसवाः शराः। एते चित्रक्रियोपेताः : सहदेवस्य धीमतः॥
en: These arrows, lustrous like the sun, painted all over with various colours and capable of destroying enemies by thousands, belong to Sahadeva.

sa: ममैते पुरुषा नित्यं कथयन्ति पुनः पुनः। रमणीयतमं लोके नगरं वारणावतम्॥
en: Dhritarashtra said: My men tell me daily again and again that the city of Varanavata is the most charming in the world.

sa: रसनं चेन्द्रियं जिह्वा रसश्चापां गुणो मतः। संघातः पार्थिवो धातुरस्थिदन्तनखानि च।॥
en: All solid substances partake of earth, as also bones, teeth, nails, beard, the hairs on the body, hair, nerves, sinews, and skin.

sa: जग्राह पार्थः स शरं प्रहृष्टो यो देवसङ्घरपि दुर्निवार्यः। सम्पूजितो यः सततं महात्मा देवासुरान् यो विजयेन्महेषुः॥
en: Partha cheerfully took up that arrow which could not be withstood even by the celestials. This great weapon, capable of discomfiting the celestials and Asuras, was always adored by the son of Pandu.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा तु वचन विरराम परंतपः। सुतः पाञ्चालराजस्य आक्रान्तो बलिना भृशम्॥
en: Having said this much, that slayer of foes, viz., the son of the Panchala king, assailed by that great hero, became silent.

sa: सुतसोमस्य सासिं तं बाहुं छित्त्वा नरर्षभ। पुनरप्याहनत् पार्श्वे स भिन्नहृदयोऽपतत्॥
en: Ashvatthaman, however, cut off Sutasoma's hand holding the sword, and once more struck him on the back. Thereat Sutasoma dropped down dead.

sa: वासुदेवसमं वीर्ये कार्तवीर्यसमं युधि। अजेयममितं युद्धे तं न पश्यामि फाल्गुनम्॥
en: He is like Vasudeva in prowess, he is invincible and matchless in battle like Kartavirya. I do not (now) see that Falguni.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एतद् वचनमाज्ञाय व्यासस्यामिततेजसः॥ अनुज्ञातो ययौ पार्थो नगरं नागसाह्रयम्।
en: Having heard these words of Vyasa of great energy, the son of Pritha, receiving his permission, returned to the city of Hastinapur.

sa: ववर्ष पुष्पवर्षं च कमलानि च भूरिशः। समश्च पन्था निर्दुःखो व्यपेतकुशकण्टकः॥
en: There was a down-fall of flowers including large numbers of lotuscs. The roads became plain and divested of prickly grass and thorns.

sa: ततः कतिपयाहस्य बीभत्सुः कृष्णमब्रवीत्। उष्णानि कृष्ण वर्तन्तं गच्छावो यमुनां प्रति॥
en: After a few days, Vivatsu (Arjuna) thus spoke to Krishna, “O Krishna, the summer is come, let us go to the Yamuna.

sa: यः समुत्पतितं क्रोधं क्षमयेह निरस्यति। यथोरगस्त्वचं जीर्णा स वै पुरुष
en: He who subdues his rising anger by forgiveness like the casting off the slough of a snake is called a true man.

sa: एवमुक्तः स भगवानब्रवीत् तावुभौ ततः। भाषमाणौ तदा वीरौ किमन्नं क्रियतामिति॥
en: Having been thus addressed, the illustrious Brahmana thus spoke to those two heroes who were enquiries what kind of food he wanted.

sa: प्रस्थाने व्यास एषां च मन्त्री प्रियहिते रतः। ततोऽगच्छन्नेकचक्रां पाण्डवाः संशितव्रताः॥
en: In their this journey, Vyasa, ever engaged in their welfare, became their counsellor. Then the Pandavas of rigid vows, arriving at Ekachakra.

sa: युगान्ते सर्वभूतानि संवर्तक इवानलः। दृष्ट्वा तु पाण्डवीं सेनां दह्यमानां महाहवे॥
en: Like the Samvartaka fire consuming all creatures at the end of a Yuga. Beholding the Pandava troops consumed in that terrible battle.

sa: वासुदेव उवाच दुर्योधनस्य कर्णस्य शकुनेश्च दुरात्मनः। दुःशासनचतुर्थानां भूमिः पास्यति शोणितम्॥
en: Krishna said: The earth will drink the will drink the blood of Duryodhana, Karna, Shakuni and the fourth (of their allies) Dushashana.

sa: एवं स भगवान् पृष्टो भरद्वाजेन संशयम्। ब्रह्मर्षिर्ब्रह्मसंकाशः सर्वं तस्मै ततोऽब्रवीत्॥
en: Thus accosted about his doubts by Bharadwaja, the illustrious and twice-born Rishi Bhrigu who took after Brahma itself, replied to him thus.

sa: मोहानुवर्ती सततं पापो द्वेष्टि च पाण्डवान्। महत्यनर्थं निर्बन्धो बलवांश्च विशेषतः॥
en: The wretch also ever hates the sons of Pandu. He is obstinate in working for their injury, besides he is very powerful.

sa: किं नु संशप्तकान् हन्मि स्वान् रक्षाम्यहितार्दितान्। इति मे त्वं मतं वेत्सि तत्र किं सुकृतं भवेत्॥
en: Shall I slay the Samshaptakas or shall I save my own army afflicted by the foe. Know this to be what I am thinking of; tell me what would be beneficial for me?

sa: ततो दशसहस्राणि न्यवर्तन्त धनुष्मताम्। मतिं कृत्वा रणे क्रूरां वीरा जयपराजये॥
en: Thereupon, ten thousand bowmen, brave and inflamed with a fierce determination for battle and disregardful of victory or defeat, turned upon (Arjuna).

sa: कलिं दुर्योधनं विद्धि शकुनि द्वापरं तथा। दुःशासनादीन् विद्धि त्वं राक्षसाशुभदर्शने॥
en: Know that Duryodhana was Kali, and Shakuni was Dvapara. O you of good features, know that Dushasana and others were all Rakshasas.

sa: एकान्तेन हि विश्वासः कृत्स्नो धर्मार्थनाशकः। अविश्वासश्च सर्वत्र मृत्युना च विशिष्यते॥
en: An absolute confidence (in his ministers) destroys both morality and profit. A want of confidence again in all worse is than death.

sa: एकं त्वां वयमाश्रित्य सहस्राक्षमिवामराः। प्रार्थमायो जयं युद्धे शाश्वतानि सुखानि च॥
en: Like celestials depending on the strength of the thousand-eyed (Indra), we relying on you alone, seek victory in battle and eternal happiness.

sa: न चास्य जीविते राजन् निर्वेदः समजायत॥ जीविताशा प्रतिष्ठिता। कृष्णाः श्वेताश्च तं वृक्षं कुट्टयन्ति च मूषिकाः॥
en: Even then, O king, he could not give up hopes of life. Still, the man expected to live. A number of black and white rates were eating away the roots of that tree.

sa: कृपणानाथवृद्धानां यदाश्रु परिमार्जति। हर्ष संजनयन् नृणां स राज्ञो धर्म उच्यते॥
en: Wiping the tears of the distressed, the helpless, and the old, and filling them with joy, form the duty of the king.

sa: स हेमविकृतं चापं विस्फार्य विजयं महत्। अवाकिरदमेयात्मा पाण्डवं निशितैः शरै॥
en: Drawing his dreadful bow made of gold, Vijaya, the valiant son of Suta, began to resist Pandu's son with his sharp arrows.

sa: तत्त्वानामथ यो वेद सर्वेषां प्रभवाप्ययौ। स धीरः सर्वभूतेषु न मोहमधिगच्छति॥
en: That wise person who understands the production and destruction of all these elements, that man among all creatures, never meets with delusion.

sa: निगृहीतो हि वायुस्ते पञ्चकर्मा शरीरगः। इन्द्रियाणि प्रसन्नानि मनसि स्थापितानि ते॥
