en: The five vital airs which act within the body have been controlled by you. You have controlled your senses within your mind.

sa: पितामह उवाच गच्छ सुन्दोपसुन्दाभ्यामसुराभ्यां तिलोत्तमे। प्रार्थनीयेन रूपेण कुरु भद्रे प्रलोभनम्॥
en: The Grandsire said : O Tilottama, go to the Asuras, Sunda and Upasunda. O amiable girl, tempt them with your desirable beauty.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तेषु त्रिषु कुमारेषु जातेषु कुरुजाङ्गलम्। कुरवोऽथ कुरुक्षेत्रं त्रयमेतदवर्धत॥
en: Vaishampayana said : On the birth of these three sons (Dhritarashtra, Pandu and Vidura), Kurujangala, Kurukshetra and the Kurus grew in prosperity.

sa: बालस्ताम्रतलं मुष्टिं कृत्वा चास्ये निधाय सः। प्राक्रोशदतिसंरब्धः सतोय इव तोयदः॥
en: Closing his coppery red fists and inserting it into its mouth, that child roared as terribly as the clouds charged with rains.

sa: ततो वृद्धांश्च बालांश्च राक्षसान् स महामुनिः। ददाह वितते यज्ञे शक्तेर्वधमनुस्मरन्॥
en: Remembering the slaughter of Shakti, the great Rishi began to consume the Rakshasas, young and old, in the sacrifice that he performed.

sa: अथ रामः कथामेतां भूय एव महायशाः। कथयामास धर्मात्मा प्रजापतिसुतस्य वै॥
en: Thereupon the highly illustrious Råma, the foremost of the pious, again began with the story of Ila, the son of the patriarch.

sa: तेषां तंसुर्महावीर्यः पौरवं वंशमुद्वहन्। आजहार यशो दीप्तं जिगाय च वसुन्धराम्॥
en: Amongst them, greatly powerful Tansu became the perpetuator of Puru's line. He subjugated the whole earth and gained great fame and splendour.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच एवं राजा स महात्मा ह्यतीव स्वैर्दोहित्रैस्तारितोऽमित्रसाहः। त्यक्त्वा महीं परमोदारकर्मा स्वर्गं गतः कर्मभिर्व्याप्य पृथ्वीम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Thus ascended to heaven that illustrious man (Yayati) of great achievements. Rescued by his kinsmen, he left the earth and filled the three worlds with the fame of his deeds.

sa: सर्वमेतन्मया ज्ञातं राजन् दिव्येन चक्षुषा। पुत्रस्तु शृणु राजेन्द्र यादृशोऽयं भविष्यति॥
en: O king, everything is known to me thought my spiritual sight. O king of kings, hear what this your son will be.

sa: तानेवमुक्त्वा दुपदस्य पुत्रः पश्चादिदं तां भगिनीमुवाच। नाम्ना च गोत्रेण च कर्मणा च संकीर्तयन् भूमिपतीन् समेतान्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Having thus addressed the assembled kings, Drupada's son (Dhrishtadyumna) then spoke thus to his sister, reciting to her the names and the lineage and the achievements of those assembled potentates.

sa: जरितोवाच अस्माद् बिलान्निष्पतितमाखुं श्येनो जहार तम्। क्षुद्रं पद्भ्यां गृहीत्वा च यातो नात्र भयं हि वः॥
en: Jarita said: The little mouse that came out of this hole was seized by a hawk with its claws and it has been carried away. Therefore, you may enter it without any fear.

sa: दुखुरुवाच न गजं न रथं नाश्वं जीर्णो भुङ्क्तेन च स्त्रियम्। वाक्सङ्गश्चास्य भवति तां जरां नाभिकामये॥
en: Druhyu said: O king, one, if he is decrepit, cannot enjoy elephants, cars, horses or women. His voice also becomes indistinct. Therefore, I do no desire (to take upon myself) your old age.

sa: ततः समुद्यतां दृष्ट्वा देवेन्द्रेण महाशनिम्। जगृहुः सर्वशस्त्राणि स्वानि स्वानि सुरास्तथा।३१॥
en: Thereupon seeing the great thunder about to be hurled by the great Indra, the celestial each took up his own respective weapon.

sa: अतः परं विचित्रार्थं शल्यपर्व प्रकीर्तितम्। हतप्रवीरे सैन्ये तु नेता मद्रेश्वरोऽभवत्॥
en: Then is told the wonderful, Parva called Shalya. After the death of all great warriors, the king of Madra became the commander.

sa: तं च मौनव्रतं श्रुत्वा वने मुनिवरं तदा। भूय एवाभवद्राजा शोकसंतप्तमानसः॥
en: Having heard that the best of the Rishi (Shamika) had been observing the vow of silence, he was doubly afflicted with sorrow.

sa: न हि केवलमस्माकं यावन्तोऽन्ये च पार्थिवाः। तथैव तेषामासीच्च बुद्धिर्बुद्धिमतां वर॥
en: O foremost of all intelligent men, this was not only our opinion, but all the other kings were of the same opinion.

sa: स तूर्यशतशङ्खानां भेरीणां च महास्वनैः। हर्षयन् सर्वशः पौरान विवेश गजसाह्वयम्॥
en: And he (Pandu), instilling joy into the hearts of his people, entered Hastinapur in a flourish of hundreds of trumpets and bugles,

sa: ह्रियमाणश्च यत्रासौ भीमसेनेन मोक्षितः। गोधनं च विराटस्य मोक्षितं यत्र पाण्डवैः॥
en: The capture of Virata by the enemy and his rescue by Bhima; the release of his kine also by the Pandava (Bhima).

sa: सर्वलक्षणसंपन्ना सुरसा चैव भामिनी। अपत्यं तु मृगाः सर्वे मृग्या नरवरोत्तम॥
en: And the beautiful Surasa of every auspicious sign. O best of men, the offspring of Mrigi are all beasts of deer species.

sa: ब्राह्मणो यदि चापल्याल्लोभाद् वा कृतवानिदम्। विप्रियं पार्थिवेन्द्राणां नैष बध्यः कथंचन॥
en: Though this Brahmana has done this injury to the kings out of his officiousness or avarice, he should not be still killed.

sa: एते तस्य सुता राजन् राजर्षर्भूरितेजसः। न्यवेशयन्नामभिः स्वैस्ते देशांश्च पुराणि च॥
en: O king, these were the sons of that greatly effulgent royal sage. The five sons founded kingdoms and cities after their names.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा तु कौन्तेया भ्रातृभिः सहितोऽनघः। अर्धकोशे तु नगरादतिष्ठद् बहिरेव सः॥
en: Having said this, that sinless son of Kunti (Arjuna) with his brothers waited outside the city at a distance of a mile.

sa: चाराः प्रस्थापिताश्चात्र निपुणाः सर्वतो दिशम्। न च प्रवृत्तिस्तैर्लब्धा पाण्डवानां महात्मनाम्॥
en: His despatch of clever spies to all countries to trace out the Pandavas; their failure to discover the mighty sons of Pandu;

sa: द्वितीयः शलभस्तेषामसुराणां बभूव ह। प्रह्लादो नाम वाह्लीकः स बभूव नराधिपः॥
en: That Asura, who was known as Shalabha the second, became king Prahlada in the land of the Bahlikas on earth. was as

sa: पञ्चालराजं दुपदे गृहीत्वा रणमूर्धनि। पर्यानयत भद्रं वः सा ख्यात् परमदक्षिणा॥
en: "Seize the kind of Panchala, Drupada, in battle and bring him to me. That will be the most acceptable Dakshina to me".

sa: सौतिरुवाच ते तथा मन्त्रिणो दृष्ट्वा भोगेन परिवेष्टितम्। विषण्णवदनाः सर्वे रुरुदुर्भृशदुःखिताः॥
en: Sauti said. The ministers, seeing their king in the coils of Takshaka, became pale with fear and they wept in great grief.

sa: नृपं शिशुं तस्य सुतं प्रचक्रिरे समेत्य सर्वे पुरवासिनो जनाः। नृपं यमाहुस्तममित्रघातिनं कुरु प्रवीरं जनमेजयं जनाः॥
en: All the citizens of the capital met together and placed the young son of the deceased king on the throne. They called that chastiser of foes, the hero of the Kuru race, Janamejaya.

sa: सरःसु फुल्लेषु वनेषु चैव प्रसन्नचेता विजहार वीर्यवान्। तथा स राजन्यवरो विजह्रिवान् यथोर्वशी प्राप्य पुरा पुरूरवाः॥
en: The greatly powerful hero roamed happily in pursuit of pleasures in lakes, in woods and in flowery fields. He passed his time in pleasure as Pururava of olden time did on receiving Urvashi.

sa: ताः सुघोरं तपस्तप्त्वा देव्यो भरतसत्तम। देहं त्यक्त्वा महाराज गतिमिष्टां ययुस्तदा॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, she perforined severe asceticism. O great king, she then gave up her body and obtained heaven.

sa: उग्रं पर्यचरद्घोरं ब्राह्मणं संशितव्रतम्। निगूढनिश्चयं धर्मे यं तं दूर्वाससं विदुः॥ तमुग्रं शंसितात्मानं सर्वयत्तैरतोषयत्। तुष्टोऽभिचारसंयुक्तमाचचक्षे यथाविधि॥
en: One day she attended upon the terrible and wrathful ascetic, vow-observing Durvasa, who was learned in the mysteries of religion and well-acquainted with truth. She, with all possible care, gratified that self-controlled ascetic.

sa: उत्ततार तत: पाशैर्विमुक्तः स महानृषिः। विपाशेति च नामास्या नद्याश्चक्रे महानृषिः॥
en: Having been freed from the cords, the great Rishi rose (from the shore) and he gave that river the name of Vipasha.

sa: जनमेजयः खल्वनन्तां नामोपयेमे माधवीम्। तस्यामस्य जज्ञे प्राचिन्वान्; यः प्राची दिशं जिगाय यावत् सूर्योदयात्, ततस्तस्य प्राचिन्वत्त्वम्॥
en: Janamejaya married Ananta, the daughter of Madhava. He begot on her a son, named Prachinvan. He was so called because he conquered all the countries in the east even where the sun rises.

sa: यस्यां लोकाः प्रसूतिश्च स्थिता नित्यमथो सुखम्। अपापां तामहं बालां कथमुत्स्रष्टुमुत्सहे॥
en: How can I abandon the innocent girl upon whom rests the region of internal bliss and my own lineage and perpetual happiness?

sa: राजा तु रक्षसाऽऽविष्टः सूदमाद गतव्यथः। अप्येनं नरमांसेन भोजयेति पुनः पुनः॥
en: The king, possessed as he was by the Rakshasas, again said to the cook without any scruple, “Feed him with human flesh."

sa: न तां स्वर्गगति प्राप्य तुष्टिं प्राप्नोति मानवः। यां श्रुत्वैव महापुण्यमितिहासमुपाश्नुते॥
en: The bliss that one enjoys in attaining heaven is scarcely equal to that which one derives from hearing this greatly holy history.

sa: सौतिरुवाच एतच्छ्रुत्वा स नागेन्द्रो वासुकिः परया मुदा। एवमस्त्विति तद्वाक्यं भगिन्या:प्रत्यगृह्णत॥
en: Sauti said : Having heard this, Vasuki, the king of the snakes, accepted the words of his sister, saying "Be it so."

sa: इष्टानि चाप्यपत्यानि द्रव्याणि सुहृदः प्रियाः। आपद्धर्मप्रमोक्षाय भार्या चापि सतां मतम्॥
en: The virtuous (men) say, that children, relatives, wives and all things dear in this world) are cherished for rescuing oneself from distress.

sa: ततः प्रववृधे गर्भो महातेजा महाप्रभः। यथा सोमो द्विजश्रेष्ठ शुक्लपक्षोदितो दिवि॥
en: O Best of the twice born, the greatly powerful and effulgent embryo began to develop like the moon in the white fortnight.

sa: ततः कथायां कस्यांचित्प्राञ्जलिः प्रग्रहो नृपः। उवाच तं महात्मानमत्रेः पुत्रं तपोधनम्॥
en: During an interval Dasaratha, with folded hands and uplifted arms, said to the high-souled son of Atri-Durbāsā, having asceticism for his wealth.

sa: उत्सृज्यापि हि मामार्य प्राप्स्यस्यन्यामपि स्त्रियम्। ततः प्रतिष्ठितो धर्मो भविष्यति पुनस्तव॥
en: O respected Sir, you can take another wife by abandoning me. You may be then again placed on the path of virtue.

sa: जनमेजयस्य यज्ञेऽस्मिन् सर्पाणां हिंसनं पुरा। परित्राणां च भीतानां सर्पाणां ब्राह्मणादपि॥
en: In days of yore, the snakes were destroyed in the sacrifice of Janamejaya, but the terrified snakes were saved by a Brahmana.

sa: सर्वे क्षयान्ता निचयाः पतनान्ताः समुच्छ्याः। संयोगा विप्रयोगान्ता मरणान्तं च जीवितम्॥
en: When there is grow there is decay, where there is prosperity there is ruin, and where there is birth there is death.

sa: अथ तस्मिन्मुहूर्ते तु ब्रह्मा लोकपितामहः। सर्वैः परिवृतो देवैर्भूषितैश्च महात्मभिः॥ आययौ यत्र काकुत्स्थः स्वर्गाय समुपस्थितः। विमानशतकोटीभिर्दिव्याभिरभिसंवृतः॥
en: There upon at that moment, Brahmă, the grandfather of all encircled by all high-souled deities and with hundred kotis of celestial cars, arrived there where Kākutstha had addressed himself to repair to heaven.

sa: यदा प्रसन्नो भगवान् महादेवो भविष्यति। तदा तुभ्यं प्रदास्यामि पाण्डवास्त्राणि सर्वशः॥
en: "O son of Pandu, when the illustrious Mahadeva (Shiva) will be pleased with you, I shall then give you all my weapons.

sa: सा त्वं मम सकामस्य सकामा वरवर्णिनि। गान्धर्वेण विवाहेन भार्या भवितुमर्हसि॥
en: O beautiful lady, I am full of desire, so are you. You should, therefore, become my wife according to the Gandharva form.

sa: कृत्वा तु कुशलप्रश्नं सर्वेण नगरेण च। न्यविशन्ताथ वेश्मानि धृतराष्ट्रस्य शासनात्॥
en: They inquired after the welfare of all the citizens. They then entered the palace assigned to them at the command of Dhritarashtra.

sa: पुरंदश्च देवेन्द्रो वरुणो धनदो यमः। महादेवः सहोमोऽत्र सदा गच्छति सर्वशः॥
en: The lord of the celestials, Purandara (Indra), Varuna, Kubera, Yama, Mahadeva with Uma (his wife), all often go there (to that Sabha).

sa: रुद्रस्यानुचरः श्रीमान्महाकालेति यं विदुः। चतुस्त्रिंशद् दनोः पुत्राः ख्याताः सर्वत्र भारत॥
en: He (Bana) was blessed with great fortune; he was a follower of Rudra and was, also known by the name of Mahakala.

sa: चिन्तयामास पापात्मा मनसा पन्नगाधमः। दष्टं यदि मया विप्रः पार्थिवं जीवयिष्यति॥
en: The sinful wretch, the worst of the snakes (Takshaka), thought in his mind, If a Brahmana revives the king bitten by me,

sa: स तु तैरभ्यनुज्ञातः कुन्तीपुत्रो धनंजयः। सहायैरल्पकैः शूरः प्रययौ यत्र सागरः॥
en: Having obtained their leave, the son of Kunti, the brave Dhananjaya, accompanied by only a few attendants, went there where the was.

sa: कुत्युवाच न विषादस्त्वया कार्यों भयादस्मात् कथंचन। उपायः परिदृष्टोऽत्र तस्मान्मोक्षाय रक्षसः॥
en: Kunti said : Do not grieve for this fear, I see a means by which you may be saved from the Rakshasas.

sa: कुत आगम्यते सौते क्व चायं विहतस्त्वया। कालः कमलपत्राक्ष शंसैतत्पृच्छतो मम॥
en: 'O Lotus-eyed, whence have you came? Where have you been, Sauti? tell me, I ask you, (all the particulars of your travels).'

sa: आयान्ति तस्यां सहिता गन्धर्वाप्सरसां गणाः। विंशतिः सप्त चैवान्ये लोकपालाश्च सर्वशः॥
en: With them come the twenty seven different tribes of the Gandharvas and of the Apsaras and others also, and also the Lokapalas,

sa: चित्रेसुर्मागधाः सर्वे स्त्रीणां गर्भाश्च सुस्रुवुः। भीमसेनस्य नादेन जरासंधस्य चैव ह॥
en: The people of Magadha becaine dumb with fear; and even many women were prematurely delivered by the roars of Bhima and Jarasandha.

sa: एवंरूपेति सा शक्या न निर्देष्टुं नराधिप। क्षणेन हि बिभर्त्यन्यदनिर्दैश्यं वपुस्तथा॥
en: O king, none is able to describe it by saying “It is such"; for it assumes an indescribable form with a moment.

sa: मामिकेयं तनु'नं सृष्टा दुःखाय लक्ष्मण। धात्रा यस्यास्तथा मेऽद्य दुःखमूर्तिः प्रदृश्यते॥
en: Forsooth, O Laksmana, the great Dispenser has created this body to suffer miseries, and all my affections are manifest in form today.

sa: अनिवार्यमसम्बाधं तव वाचा कथं वयम्। न स्पृशेम यथाकामं पुण्यं भागीरथीजलम्॥
en: Why should we not, disregarding your words, touch at pleasure the sacred waters of the Bhagirathi which is ever accessible to all.

sa: वध्यमाने ग्रहेणाथ आदित्ये मन्युराविशत्। सुरार्थाय समुत्पन्नो रोषो राहोस्तु मां प्रति॥
en: When Rahu began to devour Surya, he became angry and thought. “This enmity of Rahu has risen from my benefiting the celestials,

sa: तस्यां संजनयामास कुरुं संवरणो नृपः। तपत्यां तपतां श्रेष्ठ तापत्यस्त्वं ततोऽर्जुन॥
en: O Arjuna, the king Samvarana beget on Tapati a son, named Kuru. Born in the race of Tapati, you are called Tapatya.

sa: अर्जुन उवाच ब्रह्मचर्यमिदं भद्रे मम द्वादशवार्षिकम्। धर्मराजेन चादिष्टं नाहमस्मि स्वयंवशः॥
en: Arjuna said: O amiable girl, commanded by Dharmaraja (Yudhishthira), I am observing Brahmacharya for twelve years. I am not in my sway.

sa: चिन्तयामास कृष्णोऽथ गरुत्मन्तं स चाभ्ययात्। क्षणे तस्मिन् स तेनासीच्चैत्यवृक्ष इवोत्थितः॥
en: When coming out, Krishna thought of Garuda. As soon as thought of, he came there like a large tree worshipped by all.

sa: न्यवसन्त महात्मानो मात्रा सह परंतपाः। धृतराष्ट्रेण चाज्ञप्ता उषिता जातुषे गृहे॥
en: And those chastisers of foes, those illustrious men, lived there with their mother in the house of lac, as commanded by Dhritarashtra..

sa: सौतिरुवाच हन्त ते कथयिष्यामि नामानीह मनीषिणाम्। ये ऋत्विजः सदस्याश्च तस्यासन्नृपतेस्तदा॥
en: Sauti said : I shall tell you the names of those wise men who became the Ritvijas and Sadasyas of the king.

sa: एते चान्ये च बहवो ब्राह्मणा: वेदपारगाः। सदस्याश्चाभवंस्तत्र सत्रे पारिक्षितस्य ह॥
en: These and many others, who were vastly learned in the Vedas, became the Sadasyas in the sacrifice of the son of Parikshit.

sa: सदा भगवती लक्ष्मीस्तत्रैव नलकूबरः। अहं च बहुशस्तस्यां भवन्त्यन्ये च मद्विधाः॥
en: The illustrious (goddess) Lakshmi and also Nala-Kubera always remain there in that Sabha). Myself and many others like myself often go there.

sa: सुमन्त्रं चैव सरथं स्थीयतामिति लक्ष्मणः। उवाच शोकसंतप्तः प्रयाहीति च नाविकम्॥
en: Thereupon he ordered Sumantra to wait there with the chariot, and being beside himself with sorrow ordered the sailors to move on.

sa: धर्मं वायुं च शक्रं च विजानाम्यश्विनौ तथा। पाण्डं च कुरुशार्दूल षडेतान् कुरुवर्धनान्। पितृनेतानहं पार्थ देवमानुषसत्तमान्॥
en: O best of the Kuru race, O Partha, I know also Dharma, Vayu, Indra, Ashvinis and Pandu, these six spreaders of the Kuru race. These (six) excellent celestials and man are your fathers.

sa: तदृष्ट्वा विफलं कर्म राक्षसः पुनरेव तु। पादपान्सुबहूगृह्य शत्रुघ्नायासृजद्बली॥ शत्रुघ्नश्चापि तेजस्वी वृक्षानापततो बहून्। त्रिभिश्चतुर्भिरेकैकं चिच्छेद नतपर्वभिः॥
en: Beholding his own action baffled the Rākşasa again took up many trees and hurled them at Śatrughna, who, with three or four hundred bent arrow, cut them all, one by one, into pieces.

sa: यदाश्रौषं नरनारायणौ तौ कृष्णार्जुनौ वदतो नारदस्या अहं द्रष्टा ब्रह्मलोके च सम्यक् तदा नाशंसे विजयाय संजय॥
en: I had no hope of success, O Sanjaya, when I heard that Narada declared that Krishna and Arjuna are Nara and Narayana and they had been seen together in the region of Brahma.

sa: मरीचिरङ्गिरा अत्रिः पुलस्त्यः पुलहः क्रतुः। षडेते ब्रह्मणः पुत्रा वीर्यवन्तो महर्षयः॥
en: (It has been already said that) Marichi, Angiras, Atari, Pulastya, Pulaha and Kratu, these powerful Rishis were six mind-born sons of Brahma.

sa: काञ्चनं विष्टरं तस्मै सदस्यानुमतः प्रभुः। आसनं कल्पयामास तथा शक्रो बृहस्पतेः॥
en: The king, with the approval of the Sadasyas, offered a golden seat to the Rishi as did Indra to (his preceptor) Brihaspati.

sa: यथावत्प्रार्थित लख्वा वरं तुष्टाऽभवत्तदा। कृतकृत्या तु विनता लब्ध्वा वीर्याधिको सुतौ॥
en: Vinata, having got the boon as she requested, was much pleased and having obtained two greatly powerful sons, she regarded herself gratified.

sa: पाद्यमाचमनीयं च अर्घ्यं गां च विधानतः। पितामहाय कृष्णाय तदर्हाय न्यवेदयत्॥
en: The king then offered to his grandfather Krishna (Dvaipayana) in due form water to wash his feet and mouth, Arghya and kine.

sa: ततोऽमृतं सुनिहितमेव चक्रिरे सुराः परां मुदमभिगम्य पुष्कलाम्। ददौ च तं निधिममृतस्य रक्षितुं किरीटिने बलभिदथामरैः सह॥
en: The celestial returning to heaven, were greatly rejoiced and kept the Ambrosia in great care. Indra and other celestial made over the vessel containing Ambrosia to Nara to keep it with all care.

sa: कदूश्च लब्ध्वा पुत्राणां सहस्रं तुल्यवर्चसाम्। धार्यो प्रयत्नतो गर्भावित्युक्त्वा स महातपाः॥ ते भार्ये वरसंतुष्टे कश्यपो वनशाविशत्।
en: Kadru also obtained one thousand sons, all of equal spiendour. “Bear the embryos carefully.” So saying the great ascetic Kashyapa went into the forest, leaving his two wives much gratified with his boons.

sa: तत्रोपविष्टास्ते सर्वे पाण्डवाः कौरवाश्च ह। उपपन्नान् बहून् कामांस्ते भुञ्जन्ति ततस्ततः॥
en: On entering the palace, all the Kurus and the Pandavas sat down and began to enjoy the luxurious things provided for them.

sa: धर्मात्मा स मनु/मान् यत्र वंशः प्रतिष्ठितः। मनोर्वंशो मानवानां ततोऽयं प्रथितोऽभवत्॥
en: Manu was greatly wise and virtuous; he became the progenitor of a race. The offspring of Manu were called Manavas, (human beings.)

sa: शाश्वतं ब्रह्मपरमं ध्रुवं ज्योतिः सनातनम्। यस्य दिव्यानि कर्माणि कथयन्ति मनीषिणः॥
en: In it is described the eternal Brahma, the great true light, whose great and divine deeds the wise and learned men declare.

sa: इत्येवमुक्तः सख्या स प्रीतिपूर्वं जनेश्वरः। भारद्वाजेन पाञ्चालो नामृष्यत वचोऽस्य तत्॥
en: Having been thus joyfull addressed by his friend, the son of Bharadvaja (Drona), the king of Panchala could not bear those words.

sa: भगवान्वासुदेवश्च कीर्त्यतेऽत्र सनातनः। स हि सत्यमृतं चैव पवित्रं पुण्यमेव च॥
en: In it has also the possessor of six attributes, the eternal Vasudeva, been described. He is true and just, pure and holy.

sa: अनुसंवत्सरं जाता अपि ते कुरुसत्तमाः। पाण्डुपुत्रा व्यराजन्त पञ्च संवत्सरा इव॥
en: Those best of Kurus, the sons of Pandu, looked like five years old boys when they were only one year of age.

sa: प्रतिगृह्य तु तां पूजां पाण्डवाज्जनमेजयात्। गां चैव समनुज्ञाप्य व्यासः प्रीतोऽभवत्तदा॥
en: Vyasa was much pleased on accepting the offerings from the Pandava Janamejaya and he ordered that the kine should not be slaughtered.

sa: प्रवृद्धः सहसा पक्षी महाकायो नभोगतः। घोरो घोरस्वनो रौद्रो वह्निरौर्व इवापरः॥
en: As soon as he was born, the huge bird, increasing his body, rose to the sky, fearfully roaring like a second ocean-fire.

sa: इन्द्रस्य च भयं तीव्र सुराणां च महात्मनाम्। मांधातरि कृतोद्योगे देवलोकजिगीषया॥
en: He having been engaged in making preparations to conquer the world of gods—the celestial chief Indra with other immortals was greatly terrified.

sa: धृतराष्ट्र उवाच पाण्डोर्विदुर सर्वाणि प्रेतकार्याणि कारय। राजवद् राजसिंहस्य मात्र्याश्चैव विशेषतः॥
en: Dhritarashtra said: O Vidura, perform the funeral ceremonies of that lion of kings, Pandu and also of Madri in all proper form.

sa: ददौ दश स धर्माय कश्यपाय त्रयोदश। कालस्य नयने युक्ताः सप्तविंशतिमिन्दवे॥
en: He bestowed ten of his daughters on Daksha, thirteen on Kashyapa and twentyseven on Chandra who were all engaged in indicating time.

sa: तस्यामुपासते नित्यं महात्मानं शतक्रतुम्। मरुतः सर्वशो राजन् सर्वे च गृहमेधिनः॥
en: There daily wait upon that illustrious deity of one thousand sacrifices (Indra) all the Marutas that lead the life of house holders,

sa: पाण्डुर्जित्वा बहून् देशान् बुद्ध्या विक्रमणेन च। अरण्ये मृगयाशीलो न्यवसन्मुनिभिः सह॥
en: Pandu, after conquering many countries by his valour and wisdom, retired into a forest and took up his abode with the Rishis.

sa: केचित् तत्र नरव्याग़रभक्ष्यन्त बुभुक्षितैः। केचिदग्निमथोत्पाद्य संसाध्य च वनेचराः॥ भक्षयन्ति स्म मांसानि प्रकुट्य विधिवत् तदा। तत्र केचिद् गजा मत्ता बलिनः शस्त्रविक्षताः॥ संकोच्याग्रकरान् भीताः प्रद्रवन्ति स्म वेगिताः। शकृन्मूत्रं सृजन्तश्च क्षरन्तः शोणितं बहु॥
en: Some of them were eaten up by those best of warriors. Some were quarter d and roasted in fires lit up by them and then they were eaten by the warriors in the proper way. Many strong elephants, maddened with the pains of their wounds, fled in fear with their upraised trunks. Those wild elephants, ejecting urine and dung in fear and copiously vomiting blood, fled.

sa: सव्योरुः कामिनीभोग्यस्त्वया स च विवर्जितः। तस्मादहं नाचरिष्ये त्वयि कामं वराङ्गने॥
en: The left thigh is the seat for the wife, but you have rejected it. Therefore, O best lady, I cannot accept you.

sa: समन्ततो ददौ पश्चादग्नि तत्र निवेशने। ज्ञात्वा तु तद् गृहं सर्वमादीप्तं पाण्डुनन्दनाः॥ सुरङ्गां विविशुस्तूर्णं मात्रा सार्धमरिंदमाः। ततः प्रतापः सुमहाञ्छब्दश्चैव विभावसोः॥ प्रादुरासीत् तदा तेन बुबुधे स जनवजः। तदवेक्ष्य गृहं दीप्तमाहुः पौराः कृशाननाः॥
en: Then he set fire to that house in several places. When the sons of Pandu were satisfied that the house had caught fire in all parts. Those chastisers of foes, then speedily entered the subterranean passage with their mother. Thereupon the intense heat and the great roar of the fire. Awakened the people of the city; and seeing the house ablaze, they said in sorrowful face.

sa: निषादी पञ्चपुत्रा तु तस्मिन् भोज्ये यदृच्छया। अन्नार्थिनी समभ्यागात् सपुत्रा कालचोदिता॥ सा पीत्वा मदिरां मत्ता सपुत्रा मदविह्वला। सह सर्वैः सुतै राजंस्तस्मिन्नेव निवेशने॥ सुष्वाप विगतज्ञाना मृतकल्पा नराधिप। अथ प्रवाते तुमुले निशि सुप्ते जने तदा॥ तदुपादीपयद् भीमः शेते यत्र पुरोचनः। ततो जदुगृहद्वारं दीपयामास पाण्डवः॥
en: Impelled by fate, a Nishada woman with her five sons came there with the desire of obtaining food and she enjoyed herself there at pleasure. She drank wine and became drunk and incapable with her sons. O king, she with her sons slept in that house more dead than alive. O king, when all the people fell asleep, a violent storm began to blow on that night. Bhima then set fire to the house where Purochana was asleep; then the Pandava set fire to the door of that lac house.

sa: यदुस्तद्वचनं श्रुत्वा प्रत्युवाच नरर्षभम्। पुत्रस्ते दयितः पूरुः प्रतिगृह्णातु वै जराम्॥
en: Hearing those words of Yayāti, the foremost of men, Yadu replied: "Let your most favourite son Puru take upon himself this decrepitude.

sa: निसृष्टेषु त्वया राजन् पाण्डवेषु महात्मसु। ततोऽहं प्रेषयिष्यामि धृतराष्ट्रस्य शीघ्रगान्। आगमिष्यन्ति कौन्तेयाः कुन्ती च सह कृष्णया॥
en: O king, when the illustrious Pandavas will get your permission, I shall then send information to Dhritarashtra by quick messengers. Then, O king, the Pandavas will set out with Kunti and Krishna (Draupadi.)

sa: एवं त्वपूर्वदेहस्य वसिष्ठस्य महात्मनः। कथितो निर्गमः सौम्य निमेः शृणु यथाभवत्॥
en: I have thus described to you the story of Vasistha's birth possessing a wonderful body. Hear now what befell the king Nimi.

sa: शरीरं वासुदेवस्य रामस्य च महात्मनः। संस्कारं लम्भयामास वृष्णीनां च प्रधानतः॥
en: He then performed the cremation ceremonies of the illustrious Krishna and Balarama and of the other chief men of the Yadu race.

sa: न वर्णसंकरकरो न कृप्याकरकृजनः। न पापकृत् कश्चिदासीत् तस्मिन् राजनि शासति॥
en: During his reign, there were no mixed castes, no tillers of the land, no toilers of the mines and no sinful men.

sa: ततस्तांस्तेषु कुण्डेषु गर्भानवदधे तदा। स्वानुगुप्तेषु देशेषु रक्षां वै व्यदधात् ततः॥
en: These were then placed into the jars, filled with ghee and they were placed at a concealed spot and were carefully watched.

sa: इत्युक्त्वा भगवान् व्यासस्तथा प्रतिनिधाय च। जगाम तपसे धीमान् हिमवन्तं शिलोच्चयम्॥
en: Having said this and having made these arrangements, the illustrious and wise Vyasa went to the Himalayas mountains to perform his penances.

sa: स्वसा तस्यानवद्याङ्गी द्रौपदी तनुमध्यमा। नीलोत्पलसमो गन्धो यस्याः क्रोशात् प्रवाति वै॥
en: His sister is the slender wasted and faultless featured Draupadi, whose body emits the Perfume of lotus over full two miles around.

sa: यदि विन्देत चाकारमस्माकं स पुरोचनः। क्षिप्रकारी ततो भूत्वा प्रदह्यादपि हेतुतः॥
en: If Purochana finds from our demeanour that we have learnt his design, he may suddenly burn to death by taking immediately steps.

sa: तस्यां पुत्रानजनयच्चतुरो ब्रह्मवादिनः। तानपास्य स तत्रैव जगाम लपितां प्रति॥ बालान् स तानण्डगतान् सह मात्रा मुनिर्वने।
en: He begot on her four sons who were all utterers of the Vedas. Leaving these sons with their mother in the forest while they were still within the eggs, he went to Lapita.

sa: ततः काले बहुतिथे व्यतीते भरतर्षभ। दीक्षितः सगरो राजा हयमेधेन वीर्यवान्॥
en: O best of the Bharata race, after a long time, the mighty king Sagara installed himself for the performance of a horse-sacrifice.

sa: भीमसेन उवाच पूर्वरूपमदृष्ट्वा ते न यास्यामि कथंचन। यदि तेऽहमनुग्राह्यो दर्शयात्मानमात्मना॥
en: Bhima said: I shall never go without seeing your former form. If you are pleased with me, show me your own form.

sa: सा ब्राह्मणं तदा दृष्ट्वा संस्थितं भैक्ष्यकाक्षिणम्। कुर्वती पतिशुश्रूषां सस्माराथ शुभेक्षणा॥
en: While thus engaged in the service of her husband, she of beautiful eyes saw the Brahmana, who was still waiting for alms.

sa: स संवृतः पिशाचानां गणैर्देवगणैस्तथा। शुशुभे काञ्चने शैले दीप्यमानः श्रिया वृतः॥
en: Surrounded by the celestials and the Pishachas and seated on the golden mountain, he looked effulgent in all the grandeur of prosperity.

sa: ततोऽहं प्रयतो भूत्वा प्रणिपत्य सुरर्षभान्। प्रत्यगृहणं तदास्त्राणि महान्ति विधिवद् विभो॥
en: Thereupon, O lord bowing down to those best of the celestials and with a pure heart I duly accepted those powerful weapons.

sa: एवमुक्तस्तु भीमेन राक्षसः कालचोदितः। भीत उत्सृज्य तान् सर्वान् युद्धाय समुपस्थितः॥
en: Having been thus addressed by Bhima, the Rakshasa became alarmed. He put them down and being forced by Fate came to fright.

sa: सा तस्मै सर्वमाचष्ट यवक्रीतभाषितं शुभा। प्रत्युक्तं च यवक्रीतं प्रेक्षापूर्वं तथाऽऽत्मना॥
en: That blessed damsel told him all that Yavakrit had spoken to her and also what she herself had cleverly said to him.

sa: अस्ति मे हृदये कश्चित् तीर्थेभ्योधर्मसंशयः। तमहं श्रोतुमिच्छामि तद् भवान् वक्तुमर्हति॥
en: O exalted one, I have some religious doubts regarding Tirthas. I desire to hear you. Tell me separately of (each) in detail.

sa: एवमुक्ताः क्षणं चक्रुः पाण्डवाः सह तैर्द्विजैः। मध्यन्दिने यथाऽऽदित्यं प्रेक्षन्तस्ते महामुनिम्॥
en: Thus spoken to, the Pandavas together with the Brahmanas waited a little looking at that great saint glorious as the noon-day sun.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच तदद्भुतं महारौद्रं विन्ध्यपर्वतसंनिभम्। दृष्ट्वा हनूमतो वर्म सम्भ्रान्तः पवनात्मजः॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Seeing that dreadful and wonderful body of Hanuman like the Vindhya mountain, the son of Pavana (Bhima) grew bewildered.

sa: उदीची यो दिशं गत्वा जित्वा युधि महाबलान्। गन्धर्वमुख्याञ्छतशो हयाँल्लेभे महाद्युतिः॥
en: (Without him) who, going to the northern regions, conquered in battle hundreds of greatly powerful Gandharva chiefs and obtained greatly effulgent horses.

sa: कुन्ती च भृशसंतप्ता द्रौपदी प्रेक्ष्य गच्छतीम्। शोकविह्वलया वाचा कृच्छ्राद् वचनमब्रवीत्॥
en: Kunti, being greatly afflicted on seeing Draupadi on the eve of her journey, uttered these words in a voice choked with grief.

sa: याः काश्चन मता लोके स्वाः परमसम्पदः। जन्मप्रभृति ताः सर्वाः स्थितास्तातधनंजये।॥
en: O child, those virtues which are considered in the world as leading to heaven, reside in Dhananjaya even from his very birth.

sa: एवमुक्तः स मुनिना महीपालो विचेतनः। प्रत्याख्यानाय चाशक्तः प्रदातुं चैव नैच्छत॥
en: Having been thus addressed by the Rishi, that king fainted away. He was unable to refuse, though he was unwilling to give.

sa: स पूजितस्तेन नरर्षभेण ददर्श पुत्रं दिवि देवं यथेन्द्रम्। शान्तां स्नुषां चैव ददर्श तत्र सौदामनीमुच्चरन्तीं यथैव॥
en: Having been worshipped by that foremost of men (the king), he saw his son who looked like Indra in heaven. He saw there also his daughter-in-law Santa who looked like a flashing lightning

sa: तं वै शब्दं विदुरस्तत्त्ववेदी शुश्राव घोरं सुबलात्मजा च। भीष्मो द्रोणो गौतमश्चापि विद्धान् स्वस्ति स्वस्तीत्यपि चैवाहुरुच्चैः॥
en: At this sound, Vidura, learned in everything, and also the daughter of Subala (Gandhari), knew what it meant. Bhisma, Drona, and the learned Goutama (Kripa) also knowing it, loudly cried, "Svasti" "Svasti" (peace).

sa: स्थिरो भवस्व मोक्ष्यामि सायकानशनीनिव। घटस्व परया शक्त्या मुञ्च त्वमपि सायकान्॥
en: Stop, I shall shoot at you arrows like the thunder. Try your best if you can and shoot at me your arrows.

sa: येऽन्ये क्वचिन्मनुष्येषु तिर्यग्योनिगताश्च ये। धर्मं ते समवेक्षन्ते रक्षांसि च विशेषतः॥
en: Whether belonging to the human race or to the lower order of creatures, all pay regard to virtue, more specially the Rakshasa.

sa: ततो वातापिमसुरं छागं कृत्वा सुसंस्कृतम्। तं ब्राह्मणं भोजयित्वा पुनरेव समाह्वयत्॥
en: Thus having transformed Vatapi into a goat and after having cooked his flesh, he fed the Brahmanas and summoned him (back) again.

sa: व्यामोहयं च तान् सर्वान् रथमार्गश्चरन् रणे। तेऽन्योन्यमभिसम्मूढाः पातयन्ति स्म दानवान्।॥
en: And coursing through the field of battle on the car, bewildered them. Thus confounded, the Danavas began to fell down one another.

sa: राजानं तु कुरुश्रेष्ठं ते हंसमधुरस्वराः। आश्वासयन्तो विप्राण्याः क्षपां सर्वां व्यनोदयन्॥
en: Those foremost of Brahmanas with their swan-like sweet voices spent the night in comforting that best of Kurus, the king (Yudhishthira). son

sa: लोपामुद्रोवाच कृतवानसि तत् सर्वं भगवन् मम काक्षितम्। उत्पादय सकृन्मह्यमपत्यं वीर्यवत्तरम्॥
en: Lopamudra said : O exalted one, you have accomplished all my desires. (Now) beget on me a greatly powerful and virtuous son.

sa: स मित्रजनसंतुष्ट इह प्रेत्य च नन्दति। शब्दं स्पर्श तथा रूपं गन्धानिष्टांश्च सत्तम॥ प्रभुत्वं लभते चापि धर्मस्यैतत् फलं विदुः। धर्मस्य च फलं लख्वा न तृप्यति महाद्विज॥
en: He is pleased with his friend, in this world and he also enjoys happiness in the world next. O excellent one, know, virtuous men acquire sovereignty over all and obtain (the pleasure) of beauty, flavour, sound and touch according to their desire. O Brahmana, (an enlightened) man is not satisfied with the fruits of virtue.

sa: तत्र ते न्यवसन् वीरा वने बहुमृगद्विजे। अन्वास्यमाना मुनिभिः सान्त्व्यमानाश्च भारत॥
en: O descendant of Bharata, entertained and comforted by the Munis, there did they live in that forest abounding in birds and animals.

sa: इमामत्रोपमां चापि निबोध वदतां वर। मनुष्यलोके यच्छ्रेयः परं मन्ये युधिष्ठिर॥
en: O the best of speakers, O Yudhishthira, hear an instance of what I deem to be the highest good in this world.

sa: विष्णोर्दुर्वाससा यत्र वरो दत्तो युधिष्ठिर। वरदाने नरः स्नात्वा गोसहस्रफलं लभेत्॥
en: Where Durvasha bestowed a boon on Vishnu. The man who bathes in Vardana obtains the fruits of giving away one thousand kine.

sa: तस्य मूर्धानमासाद्य पफालासिवरो हि सः। ततो वृक्षः शिलाभिश्च योधयामास फाल्गुनः॥
en: But that best of swords on falling on his head broke into pieces. Thereupon Falguni began to fight with trees and stones.

sa: तस्याः कथं त्वनाथाया मद्विनाशाद् भुजङ्गमा सफलास्ते भविष्यन्ति मयि सर्वे मनोरथाः॥
en: And, O serpent, will all the hopes and desires that helpless woman has in me prove fruitless on account of my death?

sa: ये चान्ये प्रतियोत्स्यन्ति बुद्धिमोहेन मां नृपाः। तांश्च सर्वानहं बाणैर्नेतास्मि यमसादनम्॥
en: I will send to the abode of Yama with my arrows also those other kings that will from foolishness fight against me.

sa: ततः कदाचित् पश्यामि तस्मिन् सलिलसंचये। न्यग्रोधं सुमहान्तं वै विशालं पृथिवीपते॥
en: O ruler of earth, thereupon one day I saw in that great expanse of water a great and wide extending banian tree.

sa: युगन्धरे दधि प्राश्य उषित्वा चाच्युतस्थले। तद्वद् भूतलये स्नात्वा सपुत्रा वस्तुमर्हसि॥
en: (She said), "Having eaten curd Yugandhara and lived in Achyutasthala and at also bathed in Bhutalya you should live with your sons.

sa: श्रीपर्वते महादेवो देव्या सह महाद्युतिः॥ न्यवसत् परमप्रीतो ब्रह्मा च त्रिदशैः सह। तत्र देवह्रदे स्नात्वा शुचिः प्रयतमानसः॥ अश्वमेधमवाप्नोति परां सिद्धिं च गच्छति। ऋषभं पर्वतं गत्वा पाण्ड्ये दैवतपूजितम्। वाजपेयमवाप्नोति नाकपृष्ठे च मोदते॥
en: The greatly effulgent Mahadeva lives with his wife on the Sri mountain. There dwell also with great pleasure Brahma and the celestials. Then bathing in the Devahrada with purity and subdued mind, one obtains the fruits of Ashvamedha and attains to the highest state. Going to the Rishabha mountain in Pandya adored by the celestials, one obtains the fruits of Vajapeya (sacrifice) and rejoices in heaven.

sa: पूर्णे शतसहस्रे तु विप्राणां परिविष्यताम्। स्थापिता तत्र संज्ञाभूच्छलो ध्मायति नित्यशः॥
en: When (full) one lac Brahmanas were every day fed, it was arranged (to notify) the fact by blowing conchs in a chorus.

sa: तमसा चावृते लोके मृत्युनाभ्यर्दिताः प्रजाः। त्वामेव नाथमासाद्य निर्वृत्तिं परमां गताः॥
en: When darkness covered the world, creatures were oppressed by death; but having got you as a protector, they obtained the greatest security.

sa: एतत् प्रकाशते तीर्थं प्रभासं भास्कराते। इन्द्रस्य दयितं पुण्यं पवित्रं पापनानम्॥
en: O sun-like effulgent hero, here is the sacred Tirtha called Pravasha which is truly sacred, sin-destroying and a favourite place of Indra.

sa: अनेकाग्रं तु तं दृष्ट्वा शकुनिः प्रत्यभाषत। दुर्योधन कुतोमूलं निःश्वसनिव गच्छसि॥
en: Seeing him very much agitated (in heart), Shakuni thus spoke to him, "O Duryodhana, why are you proceeding, sighing (all the while)?

sa: एष वातिकपण्डो वै प्रख्यातः सत्यविक्रमः। नात्यवर्तत यद्द्वारं विदेहादुत्तरं च यः॥
en: O greatly powerful hero, here is the celebrated Vatikakhanda, which although near the gate of Vedika, lies on the north of it.

sa: यन्न मोहान्न कार्पण्या लोभान भयादपि। अनृतं किंचिदुक्तं ते न कामानार्थकारणात्॥
en: They say that you have never from delusion, from meanness, from covetousness, from fear, from desire or from wealth, uttered an untruth.

sa: तस्मिन् निपतिते क्षुद्रे शाल्वे बाणप्रपीडिते। रौक्मिणेयो परं बाणं संदधे शत्रुनाशनम्॥
en: When wounded by arrows, the meanminded Shalva fell down, the son of Rukmani discharged at him another arrows capable destroying every enemy.

sa: तत्र रम्ये शिवे देशे बहुवृक्षसमाकुले। पूर्वस्यां दिशि रम्यायां समुद्राभ्याशतो नृप॥
en: When, O king, towards a blessed country abounding in numerous trees and situated in the region of the east near the sea.

sa: यूयं मुमूर्षवश्चापि मन्दप्रज्ञा न संशयः। ये तस्य वचनादेवमस्मान् ब्रूत विचेतसः॥
en: You are certainly fools to rush thus to the point of death. You are senseless idiots to bring such massage to us.

sa: ततो निवातकवचा: सर्व एव स्वलंकृताः। दंशिता विविधैस्त्राणैर्विचित्रायुधपाणयः॥ आयसैश्च महाशूलैर्गदाभिर्मुसलैरपि। पट्टिशैः करवालैश्च रथचक्रैश्च भारत॥ शतघ्नीभिर्भुशुण्डीभिः खङ्गैश्चित्रैः स्वलंकृतैः। प्रगृहीतैर्दितेः पुत्राः प्रादुरासन् सहस्रशः॥
en: Thereupon, O Bharata, all those sons of Ditithe Nivatakavachas-poured in thousands, adorned with ornaments, clad in various kinds of mails and holding in their hands various weapons, (such as) javelins, mighty maces, clubs, hatchets, Pattishas, Sabres, car-wheels, Shataghnis, Bhushundis and variegated and ornamented swords.

sa: आक्रम्य च कटीदेशे जानुना राक्षसाधमम्। पीडयामास पाणिभ्यां कण्ठं तस्य वृकोदरः॥
en: Placing his knees on the breast of that wretch of Rakshasass and seizing his throat, Vrikodara (Bhima) began to press his neck.

sa: एवं बहुविधान् देशान् विजिग्ये भरतर्षभः। भल्लाटमभितो जिग्ये शुक्तिमन्तं च पर्वतम्॥
en: That best of the Bharata race (Bhima) thus brought under his sway various country of Bhallata and also the mountains of Shuktimanta.

sa: योऽसौ गच्छतिधर्मात्मा बहून् क्लेशान् विचिन्तयन् भवन्नियोगाद् बीभत्सुस्ततो दुःखतरं नु किम्॥
en: For what can we grieve more than this, that the righteous Vibhatsu goes away at your behest, thinking upon the various sorrows?

sa: अष्टावक्र उवाच चतुष्टयं ब्राह्मणानां निकेतं चत्वारो वर्णा यज्ञमिमं वहन्ति। दिशश्चतस्रो वर्णचतुष्टयं च चतुष्पदा गौरपि शश्वदुक्ता॥
en: Ashtavakra said: Four are the Ashrams of the Brahmanas; four orders perform sacrifices; four are the cardinal points; four is the number of letters and four also are the legs of a cow.

sa: यस्मात् पूर्वं मनुष्येषु ज्यायांसं मामिहाब्रवीः। सर्वदेवैश्च विप्रर्षे सम्मितं श्रेष्ठमेव च।॥
en: 'O Brahmanic sage, as you have styled me the greatest and best of men, here and have compared me with the gods,

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच ततस्तानि महार्हाणि दिव्यानि भरतर्षभ। बहूनि बहुरूपाणि विरजांसि समादद॥
en: Vaishampayana said: O best of the Bharata race, Bhima then began to gather those rare, celestials, variegated and fresh flowers in profusion.

sa: हिरण्यबिन्दुः कथितो गिरौ कालञ्जरे महान्। आगस्त्यपर्वतो रम्यः पुण्यो गिरिवरः शिवः॥
en: There is also Hiranyabindu on the great Kalanjara mountain and also that foremost of hills Agastya which is charming sacred and auspicious.

sa: राजोवाच पूर्वाह्ने ते दास्यामि यो मेऽद्य बलिरागमिष्यति। यो हन्यते कशया कथं मोघं क्षेपणं तस्य स्यात्॥
en: The king said : I shall now give by whatever tribute comes to me before the morning is expired. How can I send away a man empty-handed who has been whipped by me?

sa: तान् प्रस्थितान् परिज्ञाय कृष्णद्वैपायनः प्रभुः। आजगाम विशुद्धात्मा दृष्ट्वा दिव्येन चक्षुषा॥
en: Knowing by his spiritual eyes that they had gone away (to kill the Pandavas), that lord, the pure-souled Krishna Dvaipayana (Vyasa), came.

sa: नागैर्नदैर्नदीभिश्च दैत्यैः साध्यैश्च दैवतैः। वरुणो यादसां भर्ता वशी तं देशमागमत्॥
en: Accompanied by rivers both male and female, Nagas, Daityas, Siddhas and inferior deities, the self-possessed Varuna, the lord of waters, arrived there.

sa: स चास्य गतभी राजन् प्रतिजग्राह शासनम्। ततः शाकलमभ्येत्य मद्राणां पुटभेदनम्॥
en: He (Krishna) with all the Yadavas accepted the sway (of the Pandavas). He then went to Shakala, the city of the Madras.

sa: मार्कण्डेय उवाच ततश्चोरक्षयं कृत्वा द्विजेभ्यः पृथिवीमिमाम्। वाजिमेधे महायज्ञे विधिवत् कल्पयिष्यति॥
en: Markandeya said : Then exterminating all robbers, he (Kalki) will duly give away this earth at a great horsesacrifice to the Brahmanas.

sa: अस्याः कृते मन्युरयं त्वयि राजन् निपात्यते। बाहू ते सम्प्रधक्ष्यामि सहदेवाग्निमानय॥
en: O king, it is for her sake that my anger falls on you. I shall burn your hands. Sahadeva, bring some fire?

sa: यदि त्वहमनचाह्यः कौरव्येषु दया यदि। अन्वशाधि दुरात्मानं पुत्रं दुर्योधनं मम॥
en: If I deserve your grace and if you have kindness for the Kurus, then teach my wicked son Duryodhana (to be good).

sa: वर्षमाणा महत् तोयं पूरयन्तो वसुंधराम्। सुघोरमशिवं रौद्रं नाशयन्ति च पावकम्॥
en: Pouring a great quantity of water and filling the whole earth (with it), they extinguish that fearful, terrible and in auspicious fire.

sa: भृगुभिश्चाङ्गिरोभ्यश्च हुतं मन्त्रैः पृथग्विधैः। हव्यं गृहीत्वा वह्निं च प्रविशन्तं दिवाकरम्॥
en: He also saw that Agni, carrying oblations offered with various mantras by Bhrigu, Angira and others, entered the disc of the sun.

sa: व्यास उवाच अयमायाति वै राजन् मैत्रेयो भगवानृषिः। अन्विष्य पाण्डवान् भ्रातृनिहैत्यस्मद्दिदृक्षया॥
en: Vyasa said: O king, after having seen the Pandava brothers, there comes the illustrious. Rishi Maitreya with the desire of seeing us.

sa: को हि नाम पुमाँल्लोके मर्पयिष्यति सत्त्ववान्। सपत्नानृङ्ख्यतो दृष्ट्वा हीनमात्मामेव च॥
en: What man is there in the world possessing manliness who can bear to see his foes in prosperity and himself in destitution?

sa: रमणीयेषु देशेषु घोषाः सम्प्रति कौरव। स्मारणे समयः प्राप्तो वत्पानामपि चाङ्कनम्॥
en: "O descendant of Kuru, our cattle are now stationed in a charming place. The time for marking the calves has also come.

sa: अथ त्वामागतां दृष्ट्वा राजपुत्रीं सभां तदा। सभ्याः सर्वे विनिन्देरन् मनोभिधृतराष्ट्रजम्॥
en: O king, having gone to Krishna's (Draupadi's) house in great speed, the intelligent (messenger) informed her of the intentions of Dharmaraja (Yudhisthira).

sa: स पुत्रकामो नृपतिस्तप्यते स्म महत्तपः। पत्नीभ्यां सह राजेन्द्र कैलासं गिरिमाश्रितः॥
en: O king of kings, desiring to get a son, that king practised great austerities with his two wives on the Kailasa mountain.

sa: ज्ञात्वा बलस्थं त्रिदशाधिपं तु ननाद वृत्रो महतो निनादान। तस्य प्रणादेनधरा दिशश्च खं द्यौर्नगाश्चापि चचाल सर्वम्॥
en: Knowing that the chief of the celestials had been filled with the prowess of others, Vitra sent forth fearful roars. The earth, the directions, the heaven and the mountains all began to tremble.

sa: स्वस्ति भूतेभ्य इत्युक्त्वा महास्त्रं समचोदयम्। यत् तद् रौद्रमिति ख्यातं सर्वामित्रविनाशनम्॥
en: Saying "may all beings remain in place," and sent that mighty weapon which is named Rudra and is destructive of all enemies.

sa: एवमुक्त्वा गदां केशी चिक्षेपेन्द्रवधाय वै। तामापतन्तीं चिच्छेद मध्ये वलोण वासवः॥
en: Markandeya said : Having said this, Keshin hurled his mace to kill Indra. When falling Vasava cut it down with his thunderbolt.

sa: वसनं शयनं चैव विलयं चैव विद्धि मे। मयैव सुविभक्तास्ते देवकार्यार्थसिद्धये॥
en: Know, they are my robes, my bed, my abode. They have been spread by me to accomplish the purposes of the celestials.

sa: तस्मात् प्रसादं कुरु मे भवत्वेवं यथेच्छसि। एवमुक्तस्य शक्रेण भार्गवस्य महात्मनः॥
en: Therefore be merciful to me. Let it be as you desire." Having been thus addressed by Indra, the high-souled son of Bhrigu.

sa: यदा साम्ना न मुञ्चध्वं गन्धर्वा धृतराष्ट्रजान्। मोक्षयिष्यामि विक्रम्य स्वयमेव सुयोधनम्॥
en: O Gandharva, if you do not set the sons of Dhritarashtra free in peace, I shall certainly rescue Duryodhana by my prowess.

sa: याज्ञसेन्या वचः श्रुत्वा कृष्णो गह्वरितोऽभवत्। त्यक्त्वा शय्याऽऽसनं पद्भ्यां कृपालुः कृपयाभ्यगात्॥४५
en: Hearing the words of Yajnaseni (Draupadi), Krishna was deeply moved. Leaving his seat, the kind Deity froni compassion came there on foot.

sa: वैशम्पायन उवाच नगोत्तमं प्रस्रवणैरुपेतं दिशां गजैः किन्नरपक्षिभिश्च। सुखं निवासं जहतां हि तेषां न प्रीतिरासीद् भरतर्षभाणाम्॥
en: Vaishampayana said : Those foremost of the Bharatas, on leaving their delightful abode on that excellent mountain with waterfalls, the elephants of eight quarters, the Kinnaras and birds, were not happy at heart.
